jobs.title: Digital Project Manager - Supply Chain - Transformation Network & Pricing (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Our Supply & Material Planning Domain
,
is looking for a Digital Project Manager
based in the Upline - Villeneuve D’Ascq.

Within the Digital Value Chain teams, you will be in charge of the stream “Transformation Network & Pricing” of the initiative End-to-End Planning.

This stream focuses on the "Clean APO" project, which aims to replace the legacy SAP APO system with modern, interconnected tools for preseason planning and product pricing.

YOUR FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

As a Digital Project Manager, you will be in charge of:

Managing the Software Ecosystem: You will oversee a suite of specialized tools—including Smart Request For Quotation (product quoting), Smart Sharing (product distribution), and various pricing calculators—that manage the product lifecycle. It concerns both finished goods and components.
Overseeing Data Flow: You will ensure product data moves accurately across all systems: from initial creation (Product Lifecycle Management), through the quoting and distribution phases, to final price setup in our SAP backbone.
Coordinating Teams: You will act as a central bridge, aligning different departments (such as Sourcing, Pricing, Supply, and Industrial teams) to ensure consistency and efficiency.
Managing Complex Pricing Logic: You will oversee the technical calculations for costs, including the nuances between contract prices and final retail pricing models.
Safe System Transition: Working in tandem with Product Managers and Process Owners, you will manage the secure, step-by-step retirement of the legacy SAP APO system to ensure zero disruption to business operations.

What You Bring

Experience & Hard Skills

Senior Leadership: 3-5 years of experience managing large-scale digital projects. The ideal candidate must have a strong background in data architecture and multi-system integration.
Procurement & Commercial Strategy: Advanced proficiency in end-to-end Sourcing, Request For Quotation management, and Pricing structures within industrial and retail environments.
Enterprise Data Architecture: Expertise in Master Data Management (BOM, Basic Data) and asynchronous data integration across system landscapes via event streaming platforms (Kafka, Relay). Ideally, you have hands-on experience integrating Artificial Intelligence into your projects.
ERP Proficiency: Proven familiarity with SAP ecosystems, including both ECC and S/4HANA environments.

Soft Skills & Mindset

You have a proven ability to balance long-term vision with short and medium-term goals.
Ability to confidently facilitate steering committees with Business and Industrial Directors, and provide firm, decisive leadership when managing external integrators.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical architectures into simple, business-oriented concepts.
Experience driving international change management. Ideally, you have already contributed to a successful worldwide deployment.
Agile, focused on continuous improvement, and passionate about collective intelligence and the industrial world.
You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.
You are passionate about sports and digital technology, and you love to share and contribute.

KEY OBJECTIVES (2026-2027)

Scope Manager Build Launch: Scheduled for launch in Q3-Q4 2026.
Functional Module Build Launch: Request For Quotation, Sharing, and Quotas module build targeted for launch in Q4 2026.

What We Offer You

Remote work: up to 2 days of remote work per week ( company’s standard policy)
Equipment: Necessary equipment provided in alignment with your role and our commitments.
Global environment: A local project team within a global network (offering international career opportunities).
Professional growth: Skills development and support (diverse projects, training, etc.).
Compensation: Attractive compensation package (profit-sharing, bonuses, etc.).

DECATHLON DIGITAL CONTEXT

What if technology allowed us to push the boundaries and take sports experiences to new levels? That's exactly our goal at Decathlon Digital! We are a team of 5,000+ experts in software engineering, product management, data, cloud, and cybersecurity, distributed across Paris, Lille, and Amsterdam. Together, we are creating the largest digital sports platform, leveraging tech innovation from design to value chain optimization, connected experiences and product second life.

Changing the game for good
. We are in this for the love of sports. And like everything we love, we want it to last. That’s why we are embarking on a journey to create a more sustainable tech model, reducing our direct environmental impact while maintaining a safe, diverse, and inclusive space for all our people to learn and thrive together. Team up with us to design the digital future of sports.

jobs.title: Strategic Sourcing Program Manager-M&A
jobs.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 18 Sep 2026

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

Join our Global Supply Management team as a Strategic Sourcing Program Manager for the Mergers & Acquisition Integration Team, where you will create and drive sustainable continuous improvements to address service, ensuring supply continuity, and enhancing supplier maturity. The Mergers & Acquisitions Integration team drives end-to-end integrations that safeguard continuity, accelerate synergy realization, and scale meaningful innovation with a mission to boost value for our patients.

This position is located onsite 4 days a week at one of the following sites:

Jacksonville, FL

North Haven, CT

Minneapolis, MN

About the Position:

As the Strategic Sourcing Program Manager, M&A, you will support the Mergers & Acquisition Team by leveraging project management/analytic skills: planning & coordinating, communicating, influencing, meeting milestones, resolving issues, and managing risks. This role leads end-to-end integration planning, from diligence support and integration planning through operational handoff, with a high level of autonomy and delivery.

Primary Responsibilities:

Establish program governance, align resources, and baseline site maturity, systems, contracts, and sourcing processes to support a structured transition plan.
Build and maintain comprehensive product and supply visibility through an integrated Path to Launch (P2L), including BOMs, forecasts, lead times, supplier data, risks, and mitigation actions.
Assess and mitigate supply, capacity, quality, and continuity risks by partnering with Category management, SQE, site teams, and suppliers, while driving ASL migration, PPAP, and supplier readiness activities.
Drive supplier engagement, sourcing events, outsourcing strategies, and contract manufacturer partnerships to realize integration synergies, deliver cost savings, and enhance supply chain efficiency.
Support enterprise process and system adoption, including SAP transitions, procurement training, sourcing workflows, payment terms, MRP management, PO processing, and master data accuracy.
Coordinate cross-functional reviews, manage sourcing escalations and material availability, and execute a comprehensive handoff to Operations Sourcing with documented risks, supplier status, product information, and launch readiness plans.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of relevant strategic sourcing, continuity/run the business experience, or an advanced degree with 3+ years of relevant strategic sourcing continuity/run the business experience.

Experience in one or more of the following areas:

Category Management
Technical sourcing
Risk Assessment and mitigation
Supplier Integration
Cost Saving Initiatives

Preferred Qualifications:

7+ years in strategic sourcing operations, medical devices, or related industry
Experience with manufacturing, operational excellence, and analytics-driven improvement
Six Sigma Green Belt/Lean certification and DMAIC methodology
Strong project management, leadership, and communication skills
Skilled at leading multiple projects and collaborating across a matrixed organization
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, Project, Visio, and ideally Minitab

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R.

214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

U.S. Work Authorization & Sponsorship

At Medtronic, we are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. In alignment with our enterprise-wide workforce planning approach, U.S. work authorization sponsorship (H-1B, TN, J, etc.) is offered exclusively for Principal-level roles and above, where specialized expertise aligns with long-term business needs. Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com.

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

English version below*

Über den Bereich

Privatkundenbank – Zentrale – PB Transformation

Der Bereich Investment Solutions & Wealth Management treibt bankweite, strategisch hochrelevante Transformationsinitiativen mit erheblichem Markt‑, Regulatorik‑ und Business‑Impact. Ziel ist die nachhaltige Weiterentwicklung der Investment‑, Advisory‑ und Plattform‑Landschaft der Privatkundenbank.

Deine Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die strategische Gesamtverantwortung für hochkomplexe, bankweite Transformationsprogramme im Bereich Investment Solutions & Wealth Management
Du steuerst und entwickelst ein umfassendes Programm‑ und Change‑Portfolio mit hoher strategischer sowie regulatorischer Relevanz weiter
Du führst mehrere Programm‑ und Projektstränge und verantwortest die übergreifende Steuerung von Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und Ressourcen
Du agierst als primärer Ansprechpartner für Senior Management, Vorstand sowie CIO‑ und COO‑Funktionen und arbeitest eng mit externen Partnern zusammen
Du stellst eine nachhaltige Transformation mit messbarem Business Impact sicher (z. B. DPM‑Uptake, Effizienzsteigerungen, Verbesserung der Client Experience)
Du etablierst und entwickelst Governance‑, Reporting‑ und Steuerungsmechanismen auf Programmebene kontinuierlich weiter
Du gestaltest strategische Zielbilder aktiv mit und leitest daraus konkrete, umsetzungsorientierte Roadmaps ab

Deine Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen

Du verfügst über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Finance, Banking, Management) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Du bringst langjährige, nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung großvolumiger Transformationsprogramme im Wealth‑ und Investment‑Umfeld mit
Du verfügst über ein sehr tiefes fachliches, regulatorisches und strategisches Verständnis von Investment‑ und Advisory‑Modellen
Du überzeugst durch herausragende Führungs‑, Kommunikations‑ und Steuerungskompetenz auf Executive‑Level
Du vereinst sehr hohe analytische und konzeptionelle Stärke mit einer ausgeprägt ergebnis‑ und umsetzungsorientierten Arbeitsweise
Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Was wir bieten

Wir bieten dir eine breite Palette von Leistungen, die all deine beruflichen und persönlichen Bedürfnisse abdecken.

Emotional ausgeglichen Eine positive Haltung hilft dir, die Herausforderungen des Alltags zu meistern – beruflich wie privat. Profitiere von Angeboten wie Beratung in schwierigen Lebenssituationen und Angeboten zur Förderung deiner mentalen Gesundheit.
Körperlich fit Mit unseren Angeboten zur Aufrechterhaltung deiner persönlichen Gesundheit und einem förderlichen beruflichen Umfeld hilft dir die Bank, körperlich fit zu bleiben. Du profitierst von umfangreichen Check-up-Untersuchungen, Impfangeboten und Beratung zur gesunden Lebensführung.
Sozial vernetzt Der Austausch mit anderen eröffnet dir neue Perspektiven, bringt dich beruflich wie persönlich voran und stärkt dein Selbstvertrauen und Wohlbefinden. Profitiere von Angeboten wie Unterstützung durch den pme Familienservice, dem FitnessCenter Job, flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen (z. B. Teilzeit, Jobtandem, hybrides Arbeiten) sowie einer umfangreichen Kultur der Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit und Teilhabe.
Finanziell abgesichert Die Bank sichert dich nicht nur während deiner aktiven Karriere, sondern auch für die Zukunft finanziell ab und unterstützt deine Flexibilität sowie Mobilität – egal ob privat oder beruflich. Profitiere von Angeboten wie Beitragsplänen für Altersvorsorge, Bankdienstleistungen für Mitarbeitende, Firmenfahrrad oder dem Deutschlandticket

Die Stelle wird in Voll- und in Teilzeit angeboten.

Da die Benefits je nach Standort geringfügig variieren können, wende dich bei konkreten Fragen gerne an deinen Recruiter oder deine Recruiterin.

Bei Fragen zum Rekrutierungsprozess steht dir Marvin Hamann gerne zur Verfügung.

Kontakt Marvin Hamann: +49(69)910-45482

About The Team

Private Banking – Head Office – PB Transformation

The Investment Solutions & Wealth Management area drives bank‑wide, strategically critical transformation initiatives with significant market, regulatory and business impact. The objective is the sustainable evolution of the Private Bank’s investment, advisory and platform landscape.

Key Responsibilities

You assume overall strategic accountability for highly complex, bank‑wide transformation programmes within Investment Solutions & Wealth Management
You manage and further develop a comprehensive programme and change portfolio with high strategic and regulatory relevance
You lead multiple programme and project streams, with end‑to‑end responsibility for the overarching management of dependencies, risks and resources
You act as the primary point of contact for Senior Management, the Management Board, as well as CIO and COO functions, and work closely with external partners
You ensure a sustainable transformation with measurable business impact (e.g. DPM uptake, efficiency gains, improvement of client experience)

You actively shape strategic target operating models and derive concrete, execution‑focused roadmaps from them

Skills And Experience

You hold a successfully completed university degree (e.g. in Economics, Finance, Banking or Management) or an equivalent qualification
You bring many years of proven experience in leading large‑scale transformation programmes within the Wealth and Investment environment
You possess a very deep functional, regulatory and strategic understanding of investment and advisory models
You demonstrate outstanding leadership, communication and steering capabilities at executive level
You combine exceptional analytical and conceptual strength with a highly results‑driven and execution‑focused approach
You are fluent in German and English, both written and spoken

Since our offerings slightly vary across locations, please contact your recruiter with specific questions.

This job is available in full and parttime.

jobs.title: IT Technical Project Manager
jobs.location: City of Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
jobs.description:
Interpath is an international and fast-growing advisory business with deep expertise in a broad range of specialisms spanning deals, advisory and restructuring.

We deliver tangible results for global businesses, their investors, and stakeholders when complex problems arise, and critical decisions need to be made. Interpath is agile, independent, and conflict-free, and our passion for doing what’s right, every time, sets us apart.

Our diverse teams provide specialist technical knowledge combined with deep sector experience across our service line specialisms. Since our foundation in 2021, Interpath has grown rapidly, and we now have a presence across the UK, Ireland, France, Germany, Switzerland, Austria, Spain, South Africa, Algeria, BVI, Cayman Islands, Bermuda, Barbados, Hong Kong and Singapore. By 2030 we aim to be one of the world’s leading advisory firms with a truly global footprint.

As a rapidly growing advisory firm operating across complex and highly regulated environments, Interpath relies on secure, resilient and scalable technology to support both client delivery and internal operations.

The IT Technical Project Manager will play a critical role in leading the delivery of enterprise systems, infrastructure and tooling initiatives, ensuring they are implemented effectively, governed appropriately, and aligned to long-term architectural strategy.

This is a technically hands-on project delivery role requiring strong governance alongside the ability to engage credibly with engineers, architects and third-party providers. The ideal candidate will have progressed from a technical engineering, infrastructure or systems background into project management, bringing both hands-on technical expertise and proven delivery leadership to complex technology programs. Their technical foundation will enable them to challenge technical decisions, engage as a peer with engineers and architects, and drive successful outcomes across a diverse portfolio of strategic initiatives. You will operate as part of a globally distributed IT function with UK-based leadership, working flexibly to ensure effective collaboration and stakeholder alignment.

Responsibilities:

Lead a portfolio of complex technology initiatives across infrastructure, cloud platforms, security tooling, integrations and business-critical applications
Own end-to-end project delivery, ensuring outcomes are achieved within scope, time, cost and quality parameters
Translate strategic objectives into structured technical roadmaps and detailed implementation plans
Collaborate with engineers and architects to review and validate technical designs, integration patterns and non-functional requirements
Identify and manage technical, architectural and operational risks, embedding mitigation strategies into delivery plans
Coordinate cross-functional teams, stakeholders and third-party vendors, ensuring effective resource and capacity planning
Operate robust change governance processes, including technical impact assessment and change control
Ensure smooth transition of solutions into live environments, aligned with IT service management practices
Support vendor evaluation, technical due diligence and technology selection processes

Experience Required:

Background in a technical IT role (e.g. infrastructure, cloud, networking or similar)
Proven experience delivering large-scale IT projects end-to-end
Strong technical understanding, with confidence working alongside engineers and architects
Experience managing risks, stakeholders and complex delivery environments
Comfortable working across agile and/or waterfall methodologies
Experience working with third-party vendors
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to prioritise in fast-paced environments
Must be native or fluent in English

Desirable:

Experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS), SaaS or Microsoft 365
Exposure to cybersecurity, data migration, integrations or automation
Experience in regulated environments (e.g. financial services)
Involvement in transformation or M&A-related projects
Familiarity with ITIL or similar frameworks
Relevant certifications (e.g. PRINCE2, PMP)

Benefits

At Interpath, our people lie at the heart of our business. That's why we provide employees with a competitive and comprehensive reward package including compelling salaries and a range of core and optional benefits. Read more about our benefits; Company Benefits - Interpath

Learning & Development

Interpath provide a broad range of tailored training programs, on-the-job learning and networking opportunities help our employees develop the skills and experience required to progress on their chosen career paths.

Values

Our four core values are the cornerstones of culture at Interpath and steer everything from everyday decisions to larger strategic initiatives. Our Interpath Values are;
Do the right thing
- Our comfort zone is uncomfortable. We always make the right decision, not simply what is easy or popular.

Tu es étudiant e en licence, école d’ingénieur ou master en informatique et tu recherches une alternance de 3 ans avec un impact concret sur des projets stratégiques ? Tu aimes travailler en équipe, partager ton point de vue et collaborer pour trouver des solutions innovantes ? Cette opportunité est faite pour toi !

🔹 Qui sommes-nous ?

Nous sommes la Business Unit Fulfillment, Logistics, Transport & Customs (FLTC)
, chargée d’optimiser et de piloter les opérations logistiques mondiales de Decathlon. Notre mission ? Améliorer la performance de la supply chain grâce à des solutions digitales innovantes.

L’équipe INFRALOG
est au cœur du dispositif, elle déploie et maintient les infrastructures et les réseaux au cœur de nos activités logistiques en collaboration avec nos partenaires internes et externes.. Notre rôle est d’assurer la robustesse, la sécurité et l’évolutivité des systèmes qui permettent à Decathlon de livrer ses clients partout dans le monde. Nous travaillons main dans la main avec les équipes métiers et nos fournisseurs pour garantir disponibilité, performance et innovation.

Nous te proposons de travailler sur la partie RÉSEAU en début d’alternance afin de développer tes compétences en réseau qui te seront utiles à l’interconnexion de nos mécanisations en entrepôts. Ensuite et seulement après une période de probation réussie sur le réseau, tu pourras évoluer au sein du pôle PARTNERS afin de prendre en charge des partenaires de mécanisation, ce qui te permettra de développer des compétences en gestion de projet, en sécurité et réseau !

Ton rôle au sein du pôle RÉSEAU

Tes missions :

Gérer le support IT, la résolution d’incidents et l’optimisation des performances.
Optimiser la performance et la sécurité du réseau de nos entrepôts.
Monitorer nos équipements réseau.
Participer à des projets stratégiques de déploiement de nouvelles solutions IT.
Rédiger et mettre à jour la documentation technique.
Travailler dans un environnement international et collaboratif.

🖥️ Ton environnement technique :

🔹 Réseau
: TCP/IP, LAN, WLAN, SD-WAN.

🔹 Sécurité
: SSO, VPN IPSEC & SSL, PROXY, CERTIFICATS

🔹 Monitoring
: OpenTelemetry, Datadog.

🔹 Systèmes
: Windows 11, Chrome OS, Windows Server, Linux.

🔹 Matériel
:Switches & AP, firewalls, Servers

Ton rôle au sein de le pôle PARTNERS

Intégré e à l’équipe INFRALOG, tu contribueras à la fiabilité et la sécurité de notre infrastructure IT pour assurer un fonctionnement optimal des mécanisations de nos entrepôts logistiques DECATHLON, dont l’impact business est critique pour notre supply chain.

🖥️ Ton environnement technique :

Tu évolueras au sein d’un environnement riche et varié, comprenant notamment :

🔹 Gestion fournisseurs :
suivi de contrats, animation de comités techniques, coordination avec partenaires externes

🔹 Réseau
: TCP/IP, LAN, WLAN, WAN, SD-WAN, VPN.

🔹 Sécurité
: SSO, VPN IPSEC & SSL, PROXY, CERTIFICATS, VULN SCAN.

🔹 Systèmes
: Windows 11, Windows Servers, Linux, ISeries

🔹 Support & exploitation :
outils de ticketing et monitoring, gestion d’incidents

🔹 Documentation & partage :
wiki interne, bonnes pratiques, procédures techniques.

🔹 Méthodologies :
gestion de projet, gestion de crise, suivi de DRP.

Tes missions

Au sein du pôle Partners
de l’équipe INFRALOG, tu contribueras à :

DESIGN & ARCHITECTURE (Construire)

Pilotage des Partenaires de Mécanisation : Tu es l'interlocuteur technique privilégié de nos partenaires (Exotec, TGW, Dematic, Falcon) pour garantir le maintien en condition opérationnelle (MCO) de leurs solutions. Tu animes le suivi de nos KPI.
Humain : Tu établis/maintiens une relation de confiance avec nos partenaires
Challenger et concevoir les architectures : Tu définis et valides les solutions d'interconnexion (LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, MPLS) entre le réseau Decathlon et les écosystèmes partenaires mécanisés. Tu t'assures que leur design s'intègre parfaitement à nos standards (Cisco, Meraki).
Audit technique : Tu qualifies les architectures proposées par les nouvelles mécanisations avant leur déploiement mondial.
Piloter les projets techniques : Tu orchestres la partie Infra/Réseau lors des ouvertures de sites, extensions ou rétrofits. Tu es le garant technique du succès des nouvelles installations.

MAINTENANCE & RÉSILIENCE (Faire durer)

Garantir la haute disponibilité : Ton objectif est clair : 0 incident critique. Tu t'assures que les solutions partenaires sont robustes et performantes au quotidien.
Piloter les Plans de Reprise d'Activité (DRP) : Tu organises et supervises les tests de résilience (bascule réseau, crash tests) avec les partenaires pour garantir que les mécanisations ne s'arrêtent jamais.
Maîtriser l'obsolescence : Tu gères le cycle de vie du matériel et des logiciels (Life Cycle Management) pour éviter la dette technique et les pannes évitables.
Gérer les situations de crise : En cas d'incident majeur, tu gardes la tête froide. Tu pilotes la cellule de crise avec les partenaires, les entrepôts et les équipes internes concernées pour rétablir le service au plus vite et limiter l'impact sur nos entrepôts.

SÉCURITÉ & CONFORMITÉ (Protéger)

Sécurisation (Security by Design) les flux et les accès : Tu assures la mise en conformité des solutions partenaires (segmentation réseau, déploiement du SSO, gestion d’identité sur les interfaces WCS) pour protéger nos flux contre les cyber-menaces.
Auditer et corriger : Tu contrôles régulièrement le niveau de sécurité des installations partenaires et pilotes les plans de remédiation en cas de vulnérabilité détectée.

PROXIMITÉ (Le contact)

Incarner la culture "Terrain" : Parce que la réalité se vit en entrepôt, des déplacements réguliers sont à prévoir (France et international) pour rencontrer les équipes locales et maintenir un lien fort avec nos collègues en entrepôts.

Ce dont tu as besoin pour nous rejoindre ?

Tu as des fortes appétences en réseau et infrastructure (la connaissance des environnements logistiques est un plus).
Une réelle appétence pour la Sécurité. Tu as le réflexe de penser "protection des données" et "sécurité des accès" dans chaque projet.
Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais (B2 minimum) pour échanger quotidiennement avec nos partenaires internationaux.
Une communication fluide, de l'autonomie, de la rigueur et une capacité à garder son sang-froid (gestion de crise).
Une forte appétence pour le travail collaboratif, l'entraide et la volonté d’apprendre en continu.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

: Decathlon est certifié Great Place to Work & Happy Trainees
.

💰 Des avantages attractifs
: primes mensuelles, intéressement, actionnariat, CSE, 25% de réduction Decathlon, aide à la mobilité.

📚 Un accompagnement personnalisé
: coaching par une personne d’expérience, formations internes & externes, mentorat.

⚡ Une culture du sport et de l’innovation
: deviens ambassadeur drice
de nos produits et rejoins nos équipes sportives !

DECATHLON DIGITAL

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon.
Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. Title:
Senior Engineering Project Manager

Company:
Heven AeroTech

Location:
Bingen, Washington

Exempt

About Our Company

At Heven AeroTech (Heven), we don’t just believe in the power of people—we build our success on it. As a recognized leader in hydrogen-powered drones, we’ve earned recognition for creating a workplace where innovation thrives, collaboration is second nature, and every employee feels valued. Our culture is anchored in trust and a shared commitment to excellence.

We believe great teams are built on individuals who are humble, hungry, and smart—those who put team success first, take initiative to continuously improve, and demonstrate strong interpersonal awareness. At Heven, your voice matters, your ideas are heard, and your contributions make a tangible impact as you grow through hands-on experience and collaboration across the team.

Role Summary

Heven AeroTech is seeking a Senior Engineering Project Manager to plan, coordinate, and drive the technical execution of our unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) engineering programs. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and program management: you will own the integrated technical schedule, translate systems engineering and design requirements into executable work plans, and keep multidisciplinary engineering teams (airframe, propulsion, avionics, software, and payload) aligned against cost, schedule, and technical performance targets. Beyond running individual programs, you will build and continuously improve the engineering project management processes, tools, and gating criteria that the broader organization uses to deliver UAS hardware and software from concept through flight test and production. Success in this role requires genuine technical fluency — the ability to read requirements and drawings, understand test data, and engage credibly in engineering design reviews — combined with strong program management discipline.

Essential Responsibilities

Lead technical project management for one or more UAS engineering programs, spanning airframe/structures, propulsion, avionics, flight software, and payload integration workstreams.
Develop and maintain the integrated master schedule (IMS), work breakdown structure (WBS), and critical path analysis; proactively identify schedule risk and drive recovery plans.
Partner with systems engineering to translate requirements, interface control documents, and verification plans into actionable engineering task plans and staffing assignments.
Plan and facilitate technical design reviews and program milestones (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, flight readiness reviews), including agenda development, entrance/exit criteria, and action item tracking to closure.
Own program-level technical risk and opportunity management: identify, quantify, track, and drive mitigation of engineering risks in coordination with discipline leads.
Manage engineering change requests and configuration control in support of the company's design change (PDCR) process, ensuring changes are scoped, reviewed, and communicated to affected teams.
Develop, standardize, and continuously improve engineering project management processes, templates, and tools (scheduling, requirements traceability, risk registers, metrics/dashboards) across programs.
Manage program technical budget and resource allocation; support staffing plans and headcount forecasting in coordination with engineering leads.
Coordinate with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and test/flight operations to ensure engineering deliverables support build, integration, and flight test schedules.
Interface directly with internal leadership and external customers/partners to communicate technical status, risks, and trade-offs; prepare and deliver program reviews and status reporting.
Support compliance with applicable engineering standards, airworthiness, and regulatory requirements (e.g., FAA Part 107/UAS regulations, relevant MIL-STD or RTCA/DO guidance) as they apply to program execution.
Drive lessons-learned capture and process retrospectives at program milestones to feed continuous improvement of engineering execution practices.
Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written) is required to perform the responsibilities of this role.
This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.
If this role requires access to information controlled under U.S. export control laws (ITAR/EAR), applicants must also qualify as a "U.S. person" under 22 CFR
120.62 (U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee).
Other duties as assigned.

Required

Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
4–10 years of experience in engineering project management, technical program management, or systems engineering, ideally within UAS, aerospace, or defense product development.
Demonstrated technical fluency: able to read and interpret engineering drawings, requirements documents, interface control documents, and test/analysis data well enough to plan work and challenge technical assumptions.
Proven experience building and maintaining integrated schedules (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet) and work breakdown structures for multidisciplinary hardware/software programs.
Experience managing technical risk registers, action item tracking, and design review gating (PDR/CDR-type milestones).
Track record of developing or improving engineering project management processes, templates, or tools within an organization.
Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting technical status to engineering leadership and customers.
Working knowledge of configuration management and engineering change control processes.

Preferred

Master's degree in an engineering discipline or a technical MBA.
PMP, PgMP, or equivalent project/program management certification.
Direct experience on UAS, drone, or other aerospace/defense flight vehicle programs.
Familiarity with systems engineering lifecycle practices (requirements management, V&V/test planning, MBSE tools).
Experience with PLM/ALM tooling (e.g., Windchill, Teamcenter, Jira, Confluence) and requirements management tools (e.g., DOORS, Jama).
Familiarity with FAA UAS regulations, airworthiness processes, or relevant military/commercial aviation standards (e.g., DO-178C, DO-160, MIL-STD-810).
Experience with earned value management (EVM) or similar program performance metrics

Physical Requirements

Ability to work in both office and engineering lab environments for extended periods.
Ability to sit, stand, walk, and use a computer for prolonged periods throughout the workday.
Ability to occasionally lift and carry up to 25 pounds of engineering equipment, prototypes, test hardware, or program materials.
Ability to attend and participate in engineering design reviews, manufacturing floor activities, integration events, and flight test operations.
Ability to travel domestically up to 20% of the time, with occasional international travel as required.
Ability to access manufacturing, test, and flight operations environments, including navigating hangars, workshops, and outdoor test sites.
Ability to visually inspect engineering drawings, schedules, technical documentation, hardware, and test data.
Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and through virtual collaboration tools.

Benefits Overview

Benefits in protectional, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans, paid time off/sick, and additional protections such as critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident coverage, and short- and long-term disability.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead a large-scale software modernization initiative spanning front-end, middleware, database, testing, security, and deployment workstreams. The Project Manager owns integrated delivery performance and provides the governance, planning, communication, and risk management needed to keep technical teams and client stakeholders aligned in an Agile or hybrid Agile/Waterfall environment.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a quantitative field required. Equivalent professional experience may substitute on a two-years-of-experience-for-one-year-of-education basis.

Required Experience & Qualifications

8+ years of progressive technical and managerial experience leading IT projects of comparable scope, size, and complexity.
Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification required.
Proven experience managing Agile or hybrid Agile/Waterfall software delivery teams and multiple technical workstreams.
Experience managing integrated schedules, cost/budget, staffing, risks/issues, dependencies, change control, and executive reporting.
Experience supporting government, regulated-enterprise, or compliance-driven technology programs.
Working familiarity with enterprise architecture governance, SDLC controls, and modernization programs involving front-end, services, databases, testing, and DevSecOps.

Key Responsibilities

Own overall program performance, delivery outcomes, schedule, budget, staffing, risk, issue, dependency, and change management.
Serve as the primary program-level point of contact for client leadership and coordinate communications across technical and business stakeholders.
Develop and maintain the integrated master schedule, milestone plan, staffing plan, RAID log, decision log, and management action tracking.
Coordinate sprint/release planning with the Scrum Master and Technical Lead while maintaining visibility into cross-team dependencies and critical-path work.
Ensure requirements, design, development, testing, security, accessibility, deployment, and transition activities are incorporated into the delivery plan.
Monitor delivery metrics, quality indicators, defect trends, risks, burn rates, and milestone readiness; escalate issues early with recovery actions.
Deliver recurring status reports, executive briefings, contractual deliverables, performance reviews, and other client reporting.
Manage staffing ramp-up, onboarding, continuity, backfill, surge capacity, and knowledge-transfer planning.
Ensure adherence to contractual, regulatory, security, accessibility, documentation, and client governance obligations.
Coordinate release/readiness decisions with technical, QA, security, operations, and client stakeholders; ensure unresolved risks are documented and owned.

Core Technical Skills

Executive stakeholder management, written and verbal communication, negotiation, and issue resolution.
Project scheduling, resource planning, budget/cost control, risk management, dependency management, and delivery metrics.
Working knowledge of Angular/TypeScript, REST services, Java/.NET or Oracle SOA, Oracle databases, CI/CD, automated testing, and DevSecOps sufficient to manage cross-functional teams.
Familiarity with Section 508/WCAG, FISMA/NIST-aligned delivery environments, and configuration/change-control processes.

jobs.title: Senior Humanitarian Access Safety and Security Manager
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

Job Overview

The Senior Humanitarian Access, Safety & Security Manager (SHASSM) supports safe, effective and efficient access to and by people in need of humanitarian assistance. The role reports to the Senior HASS Coordinator and supports field locations in implementing programs aligned with the IRC’s risk appetite and strong commitment to the safety and security of our staff. The Snr HASSM ensures access and security risks are identified on time, mitigations are implemented, and staff are appropriately briefed on the security risk environment, relevant SOPs and Contingency Plans. The role will have a strong focus on providing capacity building to the Humanitarian Access, Safety & Security teams in each Field location. The Snr HASSM will also cover gaps in the HASS team in field locations and deputize for the Senior HASS Coordinator when requested.

Key Responsibilities

Humanitarian Access Management

Identify barriers to access and support the HASS and program teams in developing mitigation strategies.
Provide technical support to program teams in assessing the suitability of establishing operations in new locations
Develop relationships with local authorities as needed and other power brokers within IRC’s implementation areas.
Promote and support the integration of humanitarian access approaches into program design and implementation.
Constantly monitor available sources to collect, compile and report information to the Senior HASS Coordinator including incidents and trends pertinent to humanitarian access in areas of operations
Support key field management teams to develop and implement community engagement strategies that promote acceptance and access.
Support the Senior HASS Coordinator to ensure that IRC’s visibility strategy and profile support principled humanitarian access.

Safety and Security Risk Management

Provide technical support to the field offices and program teams on all policies, procedures, guidelines and planning for staff safety, and program continuity in Ukraine.
Contribute to the development of and updating of Security Risk Assessments (SRA) for field sites.
Contribute to the development and updating of Field Security Management Plans (SMP), including all associated contingency plans and SOPs.
Monitor the rollout and implementation of SOPs and contingency plans at a field level ensuring compliance.
Ensure effective security risk management plans for cross-border access to field sites, principally through border crossings to/from Moldova.
Ensure contingency plans for hibernation, relocation, and evacuation are known to ield staff and exercise regularly.
Ensure that all program locations and routes are routinely assessed by the HASS team to identify access and security risks in a timely manner.
Ensure all field locations meet requirements for safety and security supplies and equipment including hibernation kits, first aid kits and emergency communications.
Ensure the emergency warden systems in field locations are fit-for-purpose and tested regularly.
As requested by field teams, conduct risk assessments in new geographic locations identified for program implementation.
Deploy alongside program teams to high-risk areas and establish deployment protocols commensurate to the risk assessed.
Conduct field visits to all IRC field offices and cover HASS teams gaps when requested.
Deputize the Senior Humanitarian Access, Safety & Security Coordinator as requested.
Demonstrated experience operating at a senior / strategic level with the ability to deputize for and cover the most senior in-country security role

Capacity Building

Liaise with the HASSM to jointly draft the annual capacity building plan based on the key risks faced by frontline staff.
Support the delivery of training to field staff; deliver trainings as needed and relevant.
Support the Senior HASS Coordinator to identify the capacity-building needs of the HASS team based on the needed capacities and skills to ensure safe, secure and principled humanitarian access.
Provide on-the-job capacity building for the HASS team through mentoring, coaching, and guidance.
Support the HASS team to strengthen and expand the capacity of field teams to prepare and respond in a timely manner to emerging emergencies
Support the HASS team to deliver staff awareness and training sessions.
Support the Senior HASS Coordinator to develop and deliver training on Critical Incident Management.
In coordination with the Senior HASS Coordinator, develop a plan to promote national talent within the team to assume more responsibility.

Context Monitoring and Reporting

Monitor open sources and available information to identify changes in the context of heightened tensions.
Support the Senior HASS Coordinator in ensuring field teams are appropriately advised of the risk environment, and preparedness actions are implemented.
Support the HASS team to compile regular context updates to monitor issues that could impact program delivery.
Work closely with the HASS team to ensure all incidents and accidents are reported on IRC’s online system within 48 hours of the incident occurring.
Support the Senior HASS Coordinator in scenario planning exercises.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS

Reports to: Senior Humanitarian Access, Safety and Security Coordinator

Supervises:
None.

Key Internal Relationships: HASS Manager, HASS Officers and Assistants, Field Coordinators

Key External Relationships: Local partners, INGOs operating in field locations, Security and Access Working Groups, local authorities and stakeholders relevant to program delivery

Requirements

Job Requirements

Work Experience

A University degree in a subject relevant to humanitarian action or security such as International Relations or Political Science.
Minimum of 5 years humanitarian safety, security and access management experience with an INGO, including demonstrated capability in planning, organizing and executing security operations in the field.
Demonstrated security leadership skills including operating independently with limited oversight. This role is a senior-level experienced and independent contributor.
Demonstrated experience managing safety, security and humanitarian access across multiple high-risk or conflict-affected country contexts is required Strong understanding of the humanitarian principles required.
Demonstrated experience negotiating and expanding humanitarian access in active conflict / frontline environments Knowledge of communications technology including satellite communications.
Strong experience as a trainer.
Ability to provide dynamic verbal and written briefings on short notice.
Able to express ideas and concepts clearly and persuasively to internal and external stakeholders.
Exceptional organizational and coordination skills
Excellent relationship-building, interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively represent IRC at forums and with external stakeholders
Experience working successfully with local stakeholders such as local and international NGOs and government with sensitivity and diplomacy.
Knowledge of GIS and Google Earth is desirable.

Languages Required/Preferred

Fluency in English required.

Ability To Travel

This role requires at least 40% travel within Ukraine and therefore will not be suitable for applicants that are not willing or able to deploy to field locations regularly.

Professional Standards:
All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

Delivery of assigned V.Dockings projects in full compliance with documented V.Dockings policy and process
Overall HSSEQ and Operational performance and incident reduction during assigned V.Dockings projects
Any other agreed internal KPIs/metrics related to V.Dockings performance
Performance against agreed personal objectives for this role

Key Responsibilities and Tasks

Promoting a strong, proactive Culture of HSSEQ Excellence, through;

Continually providing strong, visible, and proactive examples of HSSEQ leadership
Promotion of a transparent & value-adding HSSEQ Excellence culture across the Group
Ensuring that docks, suppliers, and stakeholders are working and operating in a safe and environmentally sound manner, in order that the reputations, assets, and operations of V. and our customers are not impacted
Immediately escalating any concerns about the HSSEQ, operational, legal, or financial compliance of any stakeholder or representative associated with any docking project
Effective capture and reporting of learning opportunities to continually improve V.Dockings and V.Group processes

Planning and Preparation

Liaison with Fleet Cells during the planning stages, which may commence up to 18 months in advance of docking
Support and oversight of Fleet Cells in the completion of Docking Specs utilising preferred software solutions, in a timely manner and to meet necessary standards
Active participation in all relevant Fleet Cell/Customer meetings during the planning stages

Execution

Primary accountability for on-site oversight and execution of assigned dockings projects, ensuring the safe, timely, and efficient delivery of each
Provision of daily reports and required forecasts, including ongoing docking activities, budgetary changes, end and release dates, and all other such documented updates required by Fleet Cells and customers, and in compliance with V. processes
Issue and oversight of all Variation Orders required for Fleet Cell and Customer approval, in the event of required works arising during the docking that are outside the agreed docking spec
Immediate reporting, in compliance with relevant V. policy and process, of all incidents or non-compliances during the course of assigned dockings projects

Wash-Up and Continual Improvement

Ensure all learning opportunities are captured during and throughout the docking execution, for effective and timely feedback into V.’s Continual Improvement professes and programs
Active participation in all post-docking wash-up sessions, ensuring all learning opportunities are captured to ensure the continual improvement of V. policies, processes, and services
Provide subject matter expertise in above continual improvement to ensure V. policies, processes, and services remain efficient and effective, and meet industry best practices at all times
Promote a culture of collaboration and transparency with crew, yard staff, contractors, and suppliers that actively supports awareness and implementation of continual improvement at all stages of the docking process

Incident Response and Investigation

Provide immediate incident response and management where V. is impacted, ensuring that V.’s personnel, reputation and best interests are protected at all times
Act as senior V. representative on-site until relevant ShipMan and/or Group resources are deployed to take over
Ensure the preservation of all necessary physical evidence together with collection of all statements and documentary evidence that may be required, pre-empting subsequent investigation
Provide subject mater expertise and own witness input to subsequent investigations, ensuring learning and improvement opportunities are maximised for V.Dockings and V.Group, overall

Contribution To V.Group Strategy And Values

Assuring V.Group capabilities, compliance, and commitment to outstanding service delivery
Collaborating with Group, Business Unit, and Operational teams to drive safe operations in dry-docks
Ensuring consistent and efficient dockings for V.Ships and 3rd parties, in line with V.Dockings processes
Professional representation of V. at all times to customers and external stakeholders
Continually reinforcing collaboration and close working relationships between V.Group and V.Ships teams

Essential

Extensive technical experience in successfully executing dockings and large repairs across variety of vessel types (offshore and/or LPG/LNG)
Proven experience in Dry Dock Specification and Tender writing, review, and analysis
Excellent ability to make, maintain, and grow customer relations with key internal and external stakeholders
Excellent ability to represent V. to highest professional levels in external engagements
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent interpersonal skills with ability to engage and interact with people of all levels and cultures
Ability to travel & work remotely for protracted periods

What can I expect in return? V. Group can offer you a market leading salary and benefits package, in addition to significant opportunities for career growth and personal development. This a great opportunity to join a true leader in the maritime sector - a company that has exciting plans for future growth.

jobs.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Manager
jobs.description:
Hou je van analytisch werk én van sociale interactie met consultants, klanten en leidinggevenden? Heb je een bewezen track record in projectmanagement binnen ERP-projecten en de maakindustrie? Wil je projecten en services van dichtbij opvolgen en echte impact maken in een complexe, digitale omgeving? Zoek je een plek waar je kan groeien, bijdragen aan innovatie en tegelijk je kennis van Microsoft Dynamics 365 en projectmanagement verder kan verdiepen? Dan is deze rol als Microsoft Dynamics 365 FO Project Manager
bij 9altitudes
wellicht jouw volgende stap.

Je dagelijkse avontuur

Als Microsoft Dynamics 365 FO Project Manager
ben jij eindverantwoordelijk voor alle fases van implementatieprojecten en streef je naar continue verbetering van processen en resultaten.

Je bewaakt de scope, het budget en de projectplanning en volgt deze rigoureus op van project naar project.
Je staat garant voor hoogwaardige projectoplevering en zorgt voor maximale tevredenheid van de klant.
Je fungeert als Trusted Advisor en vormt de brug tussen de operationele processen van klanten en de mogelijkheden van Microsoft Dynamics 365, waarbij je behoeften vertaalt naar schaalbare digitale oplossingen.
Je stuurt projectteams aan, motiveert en coacht teamleden, en zorgt dat iedereen op één lijn zit met de projectdoelstellingen.
Je organiseert regelmatig projectgesprekken en klantvergaderingen, bijstuurt waar nodig en neemt proactief beslissingen om projecten op koers te houden.
Je rapporteert duidelijk aan het PMO Management over voortgang, budget en risico’s.
Je draagt bij aan een cultuur van verbetering en optimalisatie, zodat elk project succesvoller en efficiënter verloopt dan het vorige.

Vaardigheden

Je bent Master of een ervaren Bachelor met gelijkwaardig kennisniveau, aangevuld met minstens 5 jaar ervaring in projectmanagement bij de implementatie van IT- en bedrijfsoplossingen
Je hebt ervaring met ERP-projecten, bij voorkeur binnen de maakindustrie
Je hebt inzicht in één of meerdere businessprocessen: logistiek, productie, planning, warehouse management, verkoop, aankoop, financiën, project accounting
Je bent PRINCE2 Foundation en ITIL v4 Foundation gecertificeerd en/of bent bereid je hierin bij te scholen.
Je hebt een hands-on mentaliteit, neemt ownership over projectenen begrijpt de uitdagingen en noden tijdens transformatie- en implementatietrajecten.
Je bent vlot in Nederlands en Engels (mondeling en schriftelijk)

Je travelpack wordt gevuld met

Aantrekkelijk verloningspakket: competitief salaris, extralegale voordelen zoals hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering, maaltijdcheques en een elektrische firmawagen met laadpas.
Personaliseer je eindejaarspremie via het 9A Flexplan: extra laptop, bureaustoel of andere opties die voor jou waardevol zijn.
Werk-privébalans & flexibiliteit: we helpen je een gezond evenwicht te vinden tussen werk en privé, met de mogelijkheid tot hybride werken (thuis of op kantoor: Antwerpen, Gent, Kortrijk).
Een uitgebreide onboarding en een persoonlijk opleidingstraject: Stel samen met je teamlead een gepersonaliseerd groeipad op, afhankelijk van jouw ambities en interesses.
Ontdek en groei binnen de “9A-community”, waar kennisdeling, samenwerking en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om certificaten en opleidingen te volgen.
Afwisselende opdrachten: projecten bij diverse klanten met een focus op de maakindustrie.
Werk samen met collega’s over de landsgrenzen heen binnen de 9altitudes-groep en leer van best practices uit verschillende landen.
Versterk de band met je collega’s tijdens verbindende events zoals het nieuwjaars- en zomerevent, de jaarlijkse quiz, business updates/afterworks, de Family Day en de Elevate Together Day.
Bijdragen aan groei: speel een actieve rol in het succes en de uitbreiding van 9altitudes-activiteiten in België en Europa.
Word onderdeel van een innovatieve werkcontext met de nieuwste technologieën, binnen een Microsoft Gold en Scale Fast Partner.

Neem contact op

Bij 9altitudes
krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de internationale voorloper op technologie en procesoptimalisatie. Met meer dan 750 collega’s in 9 landen combineren we diepgaande expertise in o.a. ERP, CE, BI & AI, Document Management, PLM, IoT & Augmented Reality, CAD en eCommerce. Samen creëren we meer dan oplossingen: we leveren échte waarde en zetten mee de toon voor duurzame resultaten bij onze klanten.

Klaar om met ons mee te groeien en je carrière naar nieuwe hoogtes te tillen? Zet vandaag nog de eerste stap in jouw nieuwe avontuur en solliciteer eenvoudig via onze website.

Wil je zien hoe wij samen grenzen verleggen, innovatieve business solutions creëren en hoogtepunten vieren? Volg ons dan op LinkedIn
en blijf op de hoogte van onze projecten, successen en events.

jobs.title: Program Manager – Defense Programs
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Program Manager will lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex Department of Defense (DoD) programs and contracts. This leadership-level position is responsible for ensuring programs are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with customer requirements and organizational objectives.

The Program Manager will work closely with senior military leaders, government customers, industry partners, and internal leadership to drive program execution, operational excellence, and business growth. This role will play a key part in supporting our company growth strategy toward $200M-$300M in annual revenue
, with visibility into a $750M-$1B opportunity pipeline
.

Candidates with strong industry-side defense program management experience
are preferred over candidates whose experience is primarily on the U.S. Government side. Navy program experience is highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Program Planning & Execution

Develop and manage comprehensive program plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, and performance objectives.
Define program scope, requirements, timelines, and resource needs.
Coordinate resources across manufacturing, facilities, supply chain, engineering, and operations.
Support proposals, statements of work, specifications, pricing, and contractual requirements.
Drive program execution from initial planning through successful delivery.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

Build strong relationships with senior military leaders, government representatives, prime contractors, and industry partners.
Serve as a trusted customer-facing leader and primary point of contact for program execution.
Communicate program status, risks, milestones, and performance to internal and external stakeholders.
Manage customer expectations and proactively resolve issues.
Ensure all contractual deliverables and commitments are achieved.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Lead cross-functional program teams and establish clear roles, responsibilities, priorities, and accountability.
Coordinate activities across operations, manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, facilities, and other functional areas.
Foster collaboration and quickly resolve issues or conflicts affecting program performance.
Provide direction, coaching, and support to project team members.
Lead program management reviews, executive briefings, progress reports, and customer presentations.

Budget & Cost Management

Develop, manage, and monitor program budgets.
Track labor, materials, overhead, subcontractor, and other program-related costs.
Monitor financial performance and take corrective action when necessary.
Ensure efficient utilization of resources while maintaining program profitability.

Risk Management

Identify, assess, and prioritize program risks and opportunities.
Develop and implement mitigation and contingency strategies.
Maintain active risk registers and monitor risks throughout the program lifecycle.
Escalate critical issues and develop timely corrective actions.

Compliance, Governance & Quality

Ensure programs comply with contractual, organizational, DoD, ITAR, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Support CMMC readiness and compliance initiatives.
Establish and maintain effective program governance and quality-control processes.
Monitor program performance and address quality or compliance issues promptly.

Change Management

Evaluate and manage changes to program scope, schedule, cost, resources, and requirements.
Document and communicate approved changes to all affected stakeholders.
Assess the impact of changes and develop mitigation plans to minimize disruption.

Strategic Leadership

Serve as a leadership-level Program Manager with direct visibility to our executive leadership team.
Contribute to long-term business and program growth strategies.
Lead rapid program ramp-up and expansion efforts.
Integrate manufacturing, facilities, supply chain, and operations into overall program execution.
Develop long-term relationships with strategic suppliers and industry partners.
Apply industry best practices to strengthen supply chain performance and program delivery.

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve program execution, operational efficiency, cost, quality, and delivery.
Apply Lean Six Sigma methodologies to drive measurable improvements.
Continuously evaluate processes and implement best practices across programs.
A Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt is a plus.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, technical training, and professional experience.
PMP, PgMP, or equivalent program/project management certification required.
10+ years of progressive Program Management experience within the DoD/defense industry.
Demonstrated experience managing large-scale defense programs and contracts at the $100M+ level.
Strong preference for industry-side defense program management experience.
Navy program experience strongly preferred.
Proven ability to manage complex defense contracts, deliverables, schedules, budgets, and customer requirements.
Experience working directly with senior military leaders and government customers.
Strong understanding of defense manufacturing, supply chain, and operational environments.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office, including MS Project.
ERP system experience is beneficial.
Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.

Core Competencies

Defense Program & Contract Management
Program Planning & Execution
DoD/Navy Program Experience
Budget & Cost Management
Risk & Change Management
Customer & Executive Relationship Management
Manufacturing & Supply Chain Integration
Cross-Functional Leadership
Program Governance & Compliance
Lean Six Sigma / Continuous Improvement
Strategic Planning & Business Growth
Executive Communication & Presentation Skills

Supervisory Responsibility

This position does not have direct supervisory responsibility but will provide leadership and direction to cross-functional program teams.

Work Environment

Primarily office-based with standard physical requirements.
Occasional standing, walking, and use of hands and arms may be required.
Must have sufficient visual acuity to work with documents and computer screens.

Schedule

Full-time | Monday-Thursday | 7:00 a.m.-5:30 p.m.

Travel

Minimal travel is expected.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a senior defense-industry Program Manager
who has successfully led $100M+ DoD programs
, preferably within the Navy
, and is comfortable operating at both the executive and customer level. This individual should combine strong program execution skills with commercial awareness, manufacturing and supply chain expertise, and the ability to operate in a fast-growing organization.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on leader who can take ownership, drive accountability, solve complex problems, build customer trust, and scale programs rapidly while maintaining cost, schedule, quality, and contractual performance.

jobs.description:
Join New Era Technology, where People First is at the heart of everything we do. With a global team of over 3,000 professionals, we're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and inspired to grow. Our mission is to securely connect people, places, and information with end-to-end technology solutions at scale.

At New Era, you'll join a team-oriented culture that prioritizes your personal and professional development. Work alongside industry-certified experts, access continuous training, and enjoy competitive benefits. Guided by our core attributes — putting people first, embracing continuous learning, and thriving through collaboration and inclusion — we nurture our people to deliver exceptional customer service.

If you want to make an impact in a supportive, growth-oriented environment, New Era is the place for you. Apply today and help us shape the future of work—together

Project Manager – Audio Visual / Multimedia

Location:
Mumbai, India

Employment Type:
Permanent / Full-Time

Work Arrangement:
Client Location – Mumbai

Experience:
7–10+ years

Function:
Technology Project Management / Audio Visual & Multimedia

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Technology Project Manager – Audio Visual / Multimedia
to manage the full project lifecycle for the design, implementation, deployment, testing and commissioning of premium Audio-Visual (AV) and multimedia-enabled spaces for a global corporate across the Asia Pacific region.

The role will manage projects ranging from standard conference rooms to complex multi-purpose spaces, studios, executive/client conferencing areas and other integrated technology environments. The successful candidate will have strong hands-on experience in AV technology, project delivery, vendor management, stakeholder engagement, budgeting and commissioning of complex AV solutions.

The position is based at the client location in Mumbai
and requires the ability to collaborate effectively with global, regional and local stakeholders while delivering projects within defined timelines, budgets and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

Needs Analysis, Budgeting & Approvals
Receive and manage AV project assignments across the Asia Pacific region.
Initiate projects in collaboration with Real Estate Project Management and relevant business teams.
Gather and document client, business and Line of Business requirements.
Review architect and interior designer test-fit drawings for room types, quantities, layouts and AV requirements.
Develop AV solution markups on floor plans to clearly communicate proposed solutions to management, stakeholders and clients.
Apply global and regional standard AV room solutions to floor and room plans.
Work closely with senior AV and Engineering teams for solution reviews and technical support.
Obtain quotations from qualified AV integration partners.
Develop high-level project cost estimates, resource requirements and Statements of Work based on client requirements and AV standards.
Manage project approvals and raise requisitions/orders through Ariba.
Maintain regular, documented weekly project status updates.
Design, Vendor Engagement & Procurement
Lead project kick-off meetings with AV vendor Project Managers and ensure alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and requirements.
For custom or complex projects, develop comprehensive RFP packages, including drawings, Bill of Materials, project schedules and other relevant documentation.
Coordinate with Sourcing teams to initiate and manage the procurement process through Ariba.
Engage approved AV vendor partners and coordinate the bidding process.
Review bid leveling, commercial proposals and auction processes with Regional Heads and peer teams.
Evaluate best and final pricing in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
Coordinate kick-off meetings with awarded vendors and formally launch new engagements.
Coordinate site access, permits and other requirements for vendor surveys and project execution.
Implementation, Testing & Commissioning
Manage the complete AV implementation lifecycle from vendor quotation through Purchase Order, deployment, testing and commissioning.
Ensure vendor commitments, Purchase Orders and MSA schedules are adhered to.
Develop detailed AV project schedules covering all key milestones and dependencies.
Share project plans with Operations Leads and coordinate resource/support planning.
Integrate AV schedules with broader construction schedules and overall project plans.
Prepare project presentations and status materials for management and client stakeholders.
Obtain detailed AV asset inventories from AV vendors/hardware distributors, including serial numbers and MAC addresses.
Collate and manage subnet and network information.
For Digital Signage deployments, create Digital Signage Narratives using the approved internal template and coordinate review/approval with Regional and Corporate Communications teams.
Coordinate Digital Signage deployment schedules and calendar invitations with Corporate Communications stakeholders.
Manage AV vendors and deployment activities throughout the project lifecycle.
Monitor project budgets, costs, risks and change control.
Conduct jobsite inspections to ensure deployment progress, workmanship and quality meet defined standards.
Attend and lead internal and external project meetings as required.
Maintain accurate and current project information in the Project Tracker across the entire portfolio.
Keep regional Operations Leads informed of project progress, risks, delays, technology changes and other challenges.
Provision Telepresence/Unified Communications endpoints using approved Microsoft Teams and Zoom portal capabilities.
Provision Digital Signage endpoints using the current approved software platform.
Provision IPTV endpoints using the current approved software platform.
Coordinate Operations walkthroughs, testing and handover activities with regional leads.
Coordinate End User Orientation/Training, typically delivered by Operations teams.
Project Closeout & Handover
Notify relevant peer groups upon successful project completion.
Update completed rooms to the appropriate Active status and submit required MACD documentation to Operations.
Collect and validate all final as-built drawings, DSP files, programming codes and AV asset information from vendors.
Ensure all final project documentation is stored correctly in the designated SharePoint project folder.
Manage approved/rejected project queues and progress projects toward formal closure.
Collect final vendor invoices and coordinate submission through Ariba for final payments.
Update the Project Tracker and move completed projects to the appropriate Completed status.
Ensure all project deliverables, technical documentation and handover requirements are fully completed before project closure.

Required Skills & Experience

7–10+ years of relevant experience in Technology Project Management, Audio Visual, Multimedia, AV Integration or related technology environments.
Strong experience managing the full lifecycle of AV projects, from requirements gathering and design through procurement, implementation, testing, commissioning and handover.
Hands-on understanding of premium/professional AV systems and integrated multimedia environments.
Experience designing, integrating, implementing or managing complex AV systems.
Strong understanding of AV control systems, programming and commissioning.
Experience managing conference rooms, multi-purpose spaces, studios, executive rooms, client conferencing environments and other integrated technology spaces.
Strong experience in vendor management, procurement, budgeting, project scheduling and change control.
Experience working with MNCs/global corporate environments is highly desirable.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work across regional and global teams.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work effectively under tight deadlines and pressure.
Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in project tracking, reporting and documentation.
Experience with procurement platforms such as Ariba is an advantage.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Digital Signage and IPTV platforms is preferred.

Mandatory Certification / Professional Affiliation

CTS (Certified Technology Specialist) accreditation is mandatory.
AVIXA affiliation/membership is mandatory.

Key Competencies

Audio Visual Technology & Integration
End-to-End Project Management
AV Design & Implementation
Testing & Commissioning
Vendor & Partner Management
Budget & Cost Management
Procurement & Contract Management
Stakeholder Management
Risk & Change Management
Project Scheduling & Execution
Client Management
Communication & Presentation Skills
Problem Solving
Attention to Detail
Ability to Work Under Pressure

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will consistently deliver AV and multimedia projects on time, within budget and to required quality standards
, while ensuring strong stakeholder communication, effective vendor management, seamless commissioning and complete project documentation and handover.

Interested?

ruchitha.kalamarla@neweratech.com
