jobs.title: Private Wealth Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Position Overview

Neuberger Wealth is seeking a highly motivated and results-driven individual to lead initiatives focused on process improvement and operational excellence. This individual will play a critical role in enhancing the efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness of the Neuberger Wealth business by evaluating current processes, identifying opportunities for improvement, and driving implementation efforts. The role requires a blend of strategic thinking, operational expertise, and change management capabilities.

As a senior member of the Wealth Platforms & Experience organization, this role will be responsible for the ownership and execution of several strategic programs and analyses related to our Client and Advisor experiences. This includes activities related to the entirety of the client/account lifecycle, including everything from onboarding, maintenance, reporting, and experience, as well as their impact on Advisor tools and workflows.

Working closely with our Wealth Advisor Teams, as well as stakeholders from across the firm, this leader will advocate for a re-imagined platform that can deliver our future state capabilities for both Client and Advisor experiences.

Our choice candidate will be a detail oriented strategic thinker with a passion for solving complex problems, dealing with ambiguity, organizational design, and who possesses an unrelenting customer obsession and a strong desire to make their mark on the organization. The candidate will bring an experienced lens to analyze our current state and identify what could be integrated or improved further; while owning the implementation plan. We are looking for 12+ years of direct wealth management home office experience in roles across Operations or Business Architecture. This role is pivotal to the ongoing Private Wealth transformation, ensuring best-in-class experiences, digital enablement, and operational excellence.

Primary Responsibilities

Journey Definition & Ownership:

Own and enhance all aspects of the Client and Advisor journeys across the Private Wealth business, including all touchpoints from account opening through maintenance to reporting
Create and maintain journey maps, process flows, SOPs, and playbooks and training materials across the end-to-end client onboarding and maintenance journeys, which then informs our thinking for our next generation wealth platform
Set and deliver the vision of our future state model, specifically as it relates to client onboarding and servicing journeys
Identify friction points and implement enhancements that reduce handoffs, processing times, and error rates
Analyze current operating model, inclusive of roles and responsibilities across all areas supporting the Client and Advisor journeys
Evaluate current operating practices and implement best-in-class business processes across all aspects of the client lifecycle to drive efficiency, scalability, and risk reduction
Overhaul and fully digitize the client account opening and onboarding experience to deliver a seamless, efficient, and highly engaging process
Partner with senior level stakeholders across the firm to recommend, own, and implement changes focused on efficiency and enhanced client experiences
Establish and track SLAs and KPIs
Implement feedback mechanisms to ensure prioritization and continuous improvement efforts of platform features and business processes are accounting for Advisor and Client preferences

Technology Enablement

Drive all aspects of technology enablement across key journeys
Define key elements of future state vision and define roadmap to execute
Lead transformative efforts across the entirety of the Client and Advisor experiences
Own digital elements of Client experience as it relates to account opening, reporting, mobile app, web portal, etc.
Lead conversations with stakeholders to deliver enhancements inclusive of business requirements creation, user test scripting, release coordination, and post-launch adoption and performance

Experience & Skills Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Operations Management, Engineering or a related field. Advanced degree or certifications such as Lean Six Sigma, PMP, or similar are a plus
12+ years of experience in Wealth Management / Private Banking. Direct experience with client service, product ownership, or business analysis a plus

Ability to multi-task and manage multiple simultaneous projects
Ability to influence seniors and stakeholders outside of your span of control
Excellent time management, follow-through, and project delivery skills
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, able to simplify complexity
Exceptional analytical skills
Strategic thinker
Strong attention to detail
Highly organized
Owner of outcomes
Team player

Applicants must be authorized and have the right to work in the country where the role is located without the need for current or future sponsorship.

jobs.title: Senior Research Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview

If you've spent time studying or working outside Japan and you're ready to put that global perspective to work, this role was built for you. Japan's IT services market is one of the most complex and distinctive in the world — and IDC needs analysts who can read it from the inside while connecting it to what's happening globally. That combination is rare, and it's exactly what makes this role compelling.

About The Role

This is an opportunity to shape how the world understands Japan's IT services market — and to do it from Tokyo, at the center of one of Asia-Pacific's most dynamic technology ecosystems.

As a Research Analyst on IDC Japan's Services team, you will lead original research on Japan's IT services landscape, with a particular focus on mid-tier vendors, system integrators, and domestic local vendors that define much of the market's character. You will contribute to two flagship IDC programs — the Japan Services CIS program and the Worldwide Semiannual Services Tracker — and collaborate closely with IDC's global and Asia-Pacific analyst network.

This role is well-suited for candidates who have pursued graduate education internationally and are ready to return to Japan to build a career at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and market intelligence. You will bring a global perspective to a market that is deeply local — and that combination is exactly what our clients need.

What You’ll Do

Research & Analysis

Lead ongoing research and analysis of Japan’s IT services market, with a focus on mid-tier vendors, system integrators, and local players
Develop market forecasts, vendor share analyses, and demand-side surveys of enterprise IT buyers
Conduct primary research including interviews with IT suppliers and user companies, web surveys, and secondary data analysis
Author high-quality research reports, market perspectives, and vendor assessments for IDC’s syndicated research services

Client Engagement & Business Development

Provide direct analyst support to mid-tier clients, translating research into actionable guidance
Support business development for cloud-related subscription and custom research services
Present at external industry events and IDC-hosted events on cloud and services market trends
Engage in consulting projects and deliver advisory services to technology vendors and buyers

Global Collaboration

Partner with IDC’s Asia-Pacific and global services analysts to contribute a Japanese market perspective to IDC’s worldwide thought leadership
Build and maintain relationships with services vendors and system integrators across Japan, especially in the mid-tier and local vendor segments

What You Bring

We’re looking for candidates who combine analytical rigor, IT market knowledge, and the ability to work fluently across Japanese and international business contexts. There is no single background that defines a strong candidate — we welcome applications from those who bring experience from different angles:

IT vendor, system integrator, or consulting firm experience: Background in system development, implementation support, IT solution marketing, or business planning, with solid knowledge of the IT market
Enterprise IT buyer experience: Experience selecting and implementing vendors or systems, or managing technology planning at a client organization, with knowledge of IT products and solutions
Analyst or research background: Experience conducting IT market research, competitive analysis, or technology advisory — particularly relevant for candidates transitioning from other analyst roles

Skills & Qualifications

Japanese: Native or near-native proficiency (reading, writing, and speaking) — required for client-facing research and vendor engagement in Japan
English: Business-level proficiency for collaboration with global IDC teams, international report writing, and external communications
Education: Bachelor’s degree required; graduate degree (MBA or equivalent) a strong plus, particularly for candidates with international academic experience who are returning to Japan
Analytical tools: Proficiency in Excel (including pivot tables and data modeling), PowerPoint, and Word
Curiosity & rigor: Genuine interest in technology markets, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, compelling insights

Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

This is an ongoing talent pipeline posting. We review applications on a rolling basis and extend offers as strong candidates are identified and business needs are confirmed. Submitting your application does not guarantee an immediate opening — but it ensures your profile is considered as opportunities become available. We will reach out if your background is a strong match.

What We Offer

Individualized Culture: An environment where you can explore new areas outside your specialty and stay engaged with work you enjoy.
Hybrid Working: Hybrid working with certain days in office per week/month required. (Depends on Team)
Time-off and holidays: On top of your statutory holiday allowance and public holidays, IDC grants annually reviewed company-wide closures on 19 August (Unplug Day) and 24 December – 1 January inclusive (Global Shutdown) and a volunteering day.
A position in a highly professional and globally respected market research and advisory firm, where initiative leading to results is rewarded.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

Interventional Cardiology Therapies (ICT) brings together Medtronic’s Structural Heart, Coronary, and Renal Denervation businesses to support interventional cardiologists and heart teams with a connected, patient-focused approach. We offer a comprehensive, integrated portfolio of products aligned around the needs of the interventional cardiology service line, including innovative solutions that support the diagnosis and treatment of coronary artery disease, the restoration of structural heart functions, and the management of hypertension. 

Together, we are strengthening our impact and helping shape the future of cardiovascular care.

At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. We’re working a minimum of 4 days a week onsite as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary. 

This position will be based in Mounds View, MN.

As part of the ICT business, Coronary therapy team is seeking a driven Principal Market and Competitive Intelligence Analyst.
In this high impact role, the Analyst will provide financial forecasting, strategic planning, and investor-facing deliverables—core processes that require continuity and precision to support business performance. The Analyst functions as a central integrator across strategy, finance, and therapy teams, ensuring alignment on key assumptions, timely delivery of insights, and informed decision-making at the leadership level.

Role And Responsibilities

Support/lead preparation of key strategic deliverables including but not limited to: Strategic Plan, rolling forecasts (AOP, 7Q, 10Q),
Prepare Investor Relations materials using inputs from multiple data sources, in close collaboration with cross-functional partners (Coronary General Manager, Therapy Teams, ICT Finance Team, ICT Strategy Team). Ensure accuracy and alignment with financial and operational targets.
Support strategy/innovation opportunity assessments and prioritization process by analyzing competitor dynamics, assessing industry trends, and leveraging internal and external research and data to inform growth strategy and investment decisions.
Build and maintain strong cross-functional and regional relationships, enabling alignment and timely delivery of key inputs.
Translate complex data and analyses into clear, compelling narratives that align with and advance Coronary objectives.
Develop and synthesize market, competitive, and portfolio analyses to inform strategic choices and long‑range planning.
Serve as a strategic thought partner to Strategy/Innovation team members and cross-functionally.

Bachlelors Degree

Medical Device industry experience.
Demonstrated market, competitive, and portfolio analysis
Strong project management skills, accountability to meeting timelines
Proficiency with analytics systems such as PowerBI and Tableau

jobs.description:
Credit views on this bank's covered issuers currently rely on periodic reviews that go stale between rating cycles, and a global bank standing up its India technology and operations centre has partnered with Flexiple to hire a Credit Research Analyst who will keep those views current on its India credit research desk.
The desk you'd support

This desk covers a portfolio of corporate and financial issuers, tracking their credit profile, capital structure and covenant headroom, and feeding that analysis into the rating views and internal credit opinions used across lending, trading and risk functions. The work sits close to real decisions: a stale credit view here can show up as a mispriced position or a missed covenant breach somewhere else in the bank.
How a rating call gets made

Building and maintaining financial models for covered issuers, including leverage, coverage and liquidity metrics
Tracking covenant compliance, rating actions and credit events across the assigned portfolio
Drafting credit notes and issuer updates that summarise financial performance against thesis and triggers
Supporting senior analysts on new issuer onboarding, including first-pass credit write-ups
Monitoring macro, sector and regulatory developments that could move an issuer's credit profile

What we're looking for in a first read

2 to 6 years of experience in credit research, corporate ratings, fixed income research or related credit analysis, with strong financial modelling skills and comfort reading financial statements, indentures and credit agreements. You should be able to write a credit note that a senior analyst can sign off on with minimal rework, and be precise about assumptions in a leverage or coverage model.
Where the seat sits

The role is based out of Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad or Pune, or Remote (India), working alongside a global credit research function with regular touchpoints across time zones.
After you apply

The process includes an HR Screening, a modelling or case assignment, a Technical Round with the credit team and a final Culture Fit conversation. One application here covers this opening and any other Flexiple-matched role that fits your experience, so there is no need to reapply.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company building a new Earth observation constellation and software platform to unlock the power of thermal infrared imagery. We deliver high-resolution thermal insights that help governments, defense agencies, and agribusinesses better manage water resources, agricultural production, national security threats, and critical infrastructure.

We grow through two distinct routes to market – government programmes, and commercial data and subscription products – and our Operations team keeps the business running behind both, giving executive leadership a clear, trusted view of how the company is performing.

We are looking for an Operations Analyst
to join our Operations team and work closely with our Chief of Corporate Operations. You will help plan, coordinate, and build financial and operational models. You will also help support analysis and strategy proposals that inform how Hydrosat runs its business – from employee compensation and departmental planning, to ESG, ERM, and other org-wide efforts. You will support organization of the efficiency metrics that tell leadership where the company stands, as well as the implementation processes that result. Using Excel, PowerPoint, AI, and other tools of the trade you will turn complex, cross-functional data and workflows into clear analysis and presentation decks that senior leadership and department heads can act on, and will help with coordination and implementation across departments for such programs.

This is not a narrow reporting role. We expect our Senior Operations Analyst to be a genuine thought partner to the CCO and executive leadership – helping structure how the company thinks about its own performance, not just producing the numbers. The ideal candidate is as comfortable, for example, building a compensation model from scratch as they are distilling it into a clear, well-organized narrative for a monthly business review.

Responsibilities May Include But Are Not Limited To

Act as a flexible operations resource to the CCO, picking up cross-functional analysis, coordination, and projects as priorities shift
Build clear, well-structured Excel models and PowerPoint presentations that make complex operational and financial topics easy for leadership to act on
Prepare and help coordinate and run monthly revenue reviews, business reviews, and other leadership initiatives with the CCO, department leads and executive leadership
Partner closely with the CCO and executive leadership on corporate operations, business planning, and company financial topics
Build and maintain models and plans which may range from ERM, to ESG, OKRs, KPIs, supporting benchmarking, budgeting, and compensation planning decisions, among other key areas of org infrastructure
Help define and track efficiency metrics across departments, giving leadership a consistent way to measure how the business is performing
Support departmental modelling and planning, working with department leads to support the build-out and refinement oftheir operating plans
Develop financial and compensation models that hold up to scrutiny from leadership, the board, and investors

Job Requirements

Strong facility with Excel modelling and building polished, executive-ready PowerPoint presentations
Experience in corporate operations, business operations, or corporate finance, ideally including exposure to complex company structural and/or financing topics
A structured, organized way of thinking – you don't need to be the one presenting, but your analysis needs to tell a clear story
Comfortable working closely to support a CCO (and where needed other executive leadership directly), with thecoordination skills, judgment and discretion that requires
Ability to naturally multitask and work across a broad array of professional topics, considerations, time-zones, and other diverse daily work requirements
Excellent written and analytical communication skills
Eligible to work in the United States

Ideal Profile

Exposure to both large company and a small company priorities and underlying realities – for example, starting a career at a larger organization before moving to a startup and helping build something from scratch (or vice-versa)
A “spirit of organization and presentation”: someone who naturally organizes their thinking into a clear structure, even if presenting it to a room isn't the main part of the role, though there will be future opportunities for this as well
Comfortable working remotely as part of a distributed team; candidates based on the US East Coast are preferred

Nice to Have

Background in a startup or scale-up environment, having helped build an operations or similar function from the ground up
Experience supporting a C-level executive or executive leadership team directly
Exposure to the space, geospatial, Earth observation, or another deep-tech industry
Hands-on experience building departmental planning, efficiency, or compensation models

Employee stock options
Health insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental - Hydrosat covers 100% of employee premiums, 50% for dependents
Mental Health Support
Claims Concierge Service

401(k) with 100% match up to 4%, vested from day one
Flexible, unlimited PTO
16 paid company holidays
Maternity, Paternity & Parental Leave - up to 12 weeks fully paid
Mental health support, including free therapy sessions
Commuter and cell phone stipends
Company Discount Program

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Our Mission and Opportunity

Early education is one of the most important determinants of childhood outcomes, a critical support for working families, and a $175B market that remains underserved by modern technology. Brightwheel is the largest, fastest growing, and most loved platform in early ed, trusted by millions of educators and families every day. We are a three-time Cloud 100 company, backed by top investors including Addition, Bessemer, Emerson Collective, Lowercase Capital, Notable Capital, and Mark Cuban.

Our Team

Our team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. We embody our Leadership Principles in our work and culture. We are a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally.

Who You Are

You are a highly analytical and technically proficient Senior Data Analyst
with a proven track record of using data to inform decision-making in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. As a natural problem-solver, you excel at translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You've played a key role supporting the analytics function in a high-growth environment at a prior company, leveraging AI
to drive business outcomes.

You are a generalist at heart — equally comfortable partnering with Finance to reconcile operating and financial views, standing up reporting for external partners, and stitching the full customer lifecycle into a single narrative for leadership. You've earned the trust of leadership and external stakeholders by holding a high bar for accuracy.

What You’ll Do

You are primarily responsible for Finance and Post-Sales analytics — owning the reporting layer that bridges Sales and Post-Sales, and producing the board-ready and externally-facing reporting our leadership team and government partners depend on.
Partner directly with Finance and senior leadership to build, validate, and own the metrics that feed board reporting, AOP planning, and monthly/quarterly business reviews — including MRR/ARR, churn and retention, and revenue attribution across customer segments.
Serve as the connective tissue between Sales and Post-Sales reporting, building a consistent view of the customer lifecycle from pipeline through activation, retention, and expansion, and resolving definitional gaps between the two.
Own our external partnership reporting portfolio end-to-end, including customer-facing dashboards — translating partner data requirements into models and dashboards, and ensuring the data we hand to an external audience is accurate, appropriately permissioned, and self-service.
Build, automate, and maintain dashboards and reports in our BI tools (Sigma + Tableau) to track key cross-funnel KPIs for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

What You’ve Done

4+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a relevant technical role — preferably with Finance, Fintech, BizOps, or Retention domain experience.
Advanced proficiency in core technical analytics, including SQL (writing complex queries and manipulating data), Data Transformation (maintaining data models with tools like dbt), and Business Intelligence/Visualization with tools like Sigma or Tableau.
Demonstrated experience in creating and maintaining data models and pipelines end-to-end that served as the single source of truth.
A history of building and owning a suite of dashboards and reports in a BI tool, consistently delivering valuable insights to business stakeholders.
Excellent communication skills for stakeholder management, including acting as a trusted consultant and effectively translating technical information for all levels of an organization.
Demonstrated fluency using AI to fundamentally change how you work — not just to speed up tasks, but to automate routine workflows, accelerate analyses, and build reusable tools and data infrastructure.
Bonus: Experience with Salesforce.

This role must be available for work during standard US working hours (any 8-hour shift from 9am EST - 8pm EST).

Brightwheel is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position Reports To

Global Head of Sustainability

In our new Robotics company, you will strengthen Sustainability’s analytical backbone by building data models, templates, and dashboards that measure performance across climate, circularity, waste, water, energy and materials. You will help set up efficient tools and methods (Power BI, Excel, shared templates), ensure data quality, and enable clear insights for decision‑making across the business. You will also help digitalize and automate our processes, strengthen analytics and decision-making.

This role is part of ABB’s Robotics business, it bridges IT and sustainability, requiring someone who can code, communicate, and think strategically about data governance.

By joining us now, you’ll be part of a dynamic and fast-paced organization at the forefront of robotics innovation. As we transition into a separate entity outside the ABB Group, you’ll have the chance to shape the future, grow your career, and work alongside world-class experts in a more agile and entrepreneurial environment.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

This is a global role; the preferred locations are: Krakow or Västerås, with flexibility for the right candidate

Your Responsibilities

Build Enterprise Analytics Solutions – Develop and maintain scalable dashboards and reports using Power BI, Excel, Snowflake, and Streamlit that track Scope 1–3 emissions, circularity, waste, water, energy, and key sustainability KPIs with advanced data modelling and interactive visualizations
Standardize Data Frameworks & Templates – Design and implement reusable data collection processes, templates, and standards across Sustainability, Operations, Supply Chain, HR, Finance, and R&D to ensure consistency, quality, and audit readiness
Bridge IT & Sustainability – Translate sustainability business needs into data requirements; collaborate with IS/IT on toolchain decisions, connectors, and data infrastructure while representing the sustainability perspective
Ensure Data Integrity & Governance – Set up efficient validation, transformation, and refresh cycles; document calculation rules and assumptions; run quality checks to maintain audit-ready datasets and reliable decision-making
Enable Trend Analysis & Insights – Support topic leads with ad hoc analyses, scenario modelling (e.g., decarbonization pathways), and performance dashboards that drive strategy and accountability across the business

Essential Skills

Qualifications for the role:

Baschelors/ Masters degree in Data/Analytics, Engineering, Sustainability or a related field
 3–5 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics consulting
Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, data warehousing concepts, master data management, and building scalable reporting architectures; experience designing data validation frameworks and quality assurance processes
 Demonstrated experience managing and reporting ESG metrics, emissions accounting (Scope 1, 2, 3), circularity, waste, water, and sustainability KPIs; familiarity with building templates for multi-stakeholder data collection
Proven ability to explain complex technical analyses to non-experts, work effectively in multicultural teams, and adapt quickly as tools, priorities, and business needs evolve; fluency in English
Advanced proficiency in Power BI or Tableau, SQL for data querying and transformation, Python or R for scripting and automation, and expert-level Excel (data modeling, pivot tables, automation) is a plus.
Excellent communication skills in English

Essential Attributes

Data quality focused – You validate assumptions, document logic, and catch issues early.
Systems thinker – You understand data flows and downstream impacts.
Self-sufficient builder – You prototype practical solutions independently.
Clear communicator – You explain technical topics clearly to non-experts.
Adaptable – You stay effective as needs, tools, and priorities change.
Collaborative – You partner well with IT while representing sustainability needs.

You will join a dynamic, talented, high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager
to lead complex enterprise projects involving generative AI, LLMs, and AI-agent technologies.

This is a senior individual contributor role for an experienced PM who can take ownership of strategic projects, manage executive-level stakeholders, navigate uncertainty, and build scalable delivery practices.

You will not simply be responsible for keeping projects on schedule. You will help define how complex AI projects are planned, evaluated, delivered, and governed.

What You Will Do

Lead Strategic Projects

Own end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise projects from requirements definition through final acceptance.
Manage multiple projects concurrently, including schedules, risks, issues, dependencies, and priorities.
Lead alignment with executive-level stakeholders and business leaders.
Drive decisions around scope, priorities, change requests, and acceptance criteria.
Identify early signs of project escalation and lead recovery efforts when projects go off track.
Ensure project quality while minimizing rework and delivery risk.

Manage AI / LLM Projects

Translate business requirements into practical AI use cases and project requirements.
Balance customer expectations with technical limitations and AI-specific uncertainty.
Design and manage AI quality evaluation processes and acceptance criteria.
Incorporate risks such as hallucinations, model variability, and uncertain AI performance into project planning.
Coordinate security, compliance, legal, and information-management requirements.
Work with engineering, AI/ML, product, design, and QA teams to deliver AI-powered solutions.

Improve Delivery at an Organizational Level

Develop project templates, delivery standards, quality gates, WBS guidelines, and operating processes.
Establish and monitor delivery KPIs.
Review projects and share best practices with other PMs.
Build mechanisms for lessons learned and recurrence prevention.
Help create a delivery organization that can scale without relying on individual "firefighting."

What We're Looking For

Required

5+ years of professional project management experience in software/system development.
Experience managing projects from requirements definition through final acceptance.
Experience working directly with executives or business leaders.
Strong stakeholder management across business, engineering, sales, customer success, and other functions.
Demonstrated experience turning around difficult or escalated projects.
Native-level or near-native Japanese communication skills.

Preferred

Experience with generative AI, LLM, RAG, AI agents, AI evaluation, or AI operations.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects or portfolios.
Agile/Scrum experience and/or strong Waterfall/change-management experience.
Experience with contracts, estimates, change management, project costs, or profitability.
PMO or delivery-standardization experience.
PMP, PMI, IPA Project Manager, or equivalent certification/knowledge.
Business-level English and experience working with multinational teams.

The Ideal Candidate

You Are Someone Who

Can structure ambiguous and uncertain problems.
Can make complex projects understandable and actionable.
Can influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
Communicates risks and bad news early.
Can recover difficult projects while maintaining stakeholder trust.
Thinks beyond individual project success and builds repeatable processes.
Is comfortable operating in a rapidly changing AI environment.

Why Join?

Work at the forefront of generative AI and AI-agent technology.
Lead high-impact enterprise projects with significant business visibility.
Work closely with senior business and technology stakeholders.
Gain hands-on experience managing the unique challenges of AI delivery.
Help establish the project management and delivery standards for a rapidly scaling AI business.

Lead remote & local teams in the delivery of projects simultaneously, ensuring alignment and timely delivery

Partner with Facilities Operations, Real Estate, EHS, Quality, IT, Design, Security, Engineering, Sourcing, Finance, Legal, Manufacturing, and site leadership to ensure alignment to local & national regulatory requirements, applicable corporate policies, commissioning, qualification requirements, and the successful transition to Facility Operations

Hold team members accountable for commitments and deliverables, maintaining transparency and tracking progress

role requires multidimensional skills, including understanding cogeneration plants, managing relationships with contractors, engineers, peers, operations and maintenance staff, and customers, as well as strong communication, leadership, and delegation abilities.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Your Growth Unleashed

Where your journey begins and your potential shines

At Synpulse, we don’t just consult – we transform. As a leading global management and technology consultancy with Swiss roots, we empower financial institutions to navigate change and seize new opportunities. Since 1996, we've been shaping the future of financial services by delivering cutting-edge expertise in strategy, operations, and technology to banks and insurers worldwide.

What sets us apart is our people. At Synpulse, we cultivate a collaborative, high-impact culture where initiative and creativity are valued. With 21 offices across Europe, the Americas, and Asia-Pacific, we bring together diverse perspectives and talents. We believe innovation thrives where everyone feels they belong and can contribute.

Our core values – Embrace, Drive, Achieve – shape how we work and evolve. We don’t just offer jobs – we offer the chance to develop, make an impact, and be part of a team that’s redefining the future of financial services.

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Consultant - Reinsurance Business Data Analyst for a role focused on helping clients better understand, structure, and use their data to support data driven decision-making.

The role combines strong reinsurance domain knowledge with data analysis and business analysis skills. You will work closely with client stakeholders across multiple domains, including but not limited to finance, underwriting, claims, etc. to analyse data structures, clarify business definitions, identify gaps, and translate complex domain concepts into clear, scalable data-driven solutions such as data products and analytical datasets.

This is not a pure technical or engineering role. It requires confident stakeholder engagement, structured problem-solving, and the ability to bridge business needs with data and technology teams in a consulting environment.

Key Responsibilities

You will act as a business-facing data analyst, working with client stakeholders to understand business questions, data needs, and decision-making requirements, and translating these into clear data and analytical requirements.
Analyse existing data structures, definitions, and flows to identify inconsistencies, gaps, and improvement opportunities across data domains.
Support the design and evolution of data-driven solutions (e.g. data products, curated datasets, analytical views) by contributing domain expertise, business logic, and clear definitions.
Collaborate with data engineers, architects, and technology teams to ensure business requirements are accurately reflected in implemented data solutions.
Perform data analysis and validation using SQL/Python to investigate issues, test assumptions, and support solution design
Support impact analysis and change discussions when data structures, definitions, or logic evolve, ensuring business implications are clearly understood.
Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders through clear communication, structured workshops, and pragmatic problem-solving.
Demonstrate a strong understanding of reinsurance data across core areas such as policies, risks, premiums, claims, exposures, transactions, and reinsurance arrangements.

Job Requirements

Proven experience in a London Market / UK Insurance / Reinsurance / Insurtech or consultancy firm with exposure to Insurance / Reinsurance clients. While there is no fixed minimum threshold of experience required working in these sectors, candidates for these roles would typically have had exposure to these sectors (or equivalent relevant experience) for at least three years.
Experience working with reinsurance data.
Prior involvement in data, analytics, or data transformation initiatives within reinsurance organizations.
Strong understanding of reinsurance concepts and processes, with the ability to apply this knowledge in data and analytical contexts.
Proven experience working as a business data analyst, or similar role within reinsurance environments.
Advanced SQL skills for data analysis, investigation, and validation.
Ability to structure ambiguous problems and translate complex business topics into clear, actionable data requirements.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence to engage both business and technical audiences.
Consulting mindset with a focus on delivering practical, high-quality outcomes in client environments.
Advanced communication, presentation and facilitation skills help you in effective communication with stakeholders at various levels across organisations.
Understanding of key data & AI platforms and solutions used in the (Re)insurance sector and ability to identify opportunities for improvements.
Bachelor’s degree, with an advanced degree (MBA, MSc, MA) and/or equivalent experience. Additional qualifications being a plus.
Professional qualifications (e.g. ACA, ACCA, CIMA, insurance-related certifications) are beneficial but not essential.

Additional Requirements

The successful candidate will need to be UK-based, with flexibility for client site engagement if required.

Job Benefits

Why us:

A unique opportunity to shape the UK office through participating in internal initiatives (CSR, DE&I, recruitment, marketing).
As part of our onboarding, take part in our two-week New Employee Training (NET), an engaging programme with interactive, level-specific modules on Synpulse, processes, tools, communication, and role-specific skills, designed to integrate you into the team and set you up for success.
Continual and comprehensive learning and development through our Academy Program.
Innovative team bonus scheme following our "One Spirit" approach.
Hybrid working environment.  

Alongside a competitive salary, you'll get lots of other great benefits too:

25 days annual leave plus bank holidays in England
Pension: 6% employer contribution and 3% employee contribution
Paid time off for volunteering (2 days per year)
Private medical insurance with dental care through Vitality
Life insurance
Enhanced family friendly policies
Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 mental health support
Interest free season ticket loan.
Access to the Cycle scheme and Tech scheme

Ready to go further? Let’s unleash your growth — together

For more information, please visit us at www.synpulse.com

At Synpulse, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive environment for all candidates. Throughout the interview process, we strive to accommodate diverse needs and preferences to ensure that every candidate can fully showcase their abilities. If you require any accommodations or adjustments to the interview process to support your participation, please don't hesitate to let us know. We are here to make the interview experience as comfortable and accessible as possible for you.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Bridge
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

About The Team

Join our Technical Program Management team to build the systems that make global, programmable money trustworthy at scale. At Bridge, we’re not just improving global payments—we’re reinventing how money moves across borders using stablecoins and modern financial infrastructure.

This role is about driving execution across complex technical initiatives—bringing structure to ambiguous problems, aligning stakeholders, and helping the team move quickly while maintaining reliability, performance, and operational excellence.

What you’ll do

As a TPM, you'll play a key role leading complex programs across multiple engineering, product, and cross-functional (finance, legal, compliance, risk, and other) teams spanning Bridge. You'll be an active contributor to the overall strategy of the program, drive technical decision-making, and drive the execution of the program through all phases from planning to delivery. You'll have the opportunity to implement mechanisms that make your programs effective and scale them to Bridge-level processes.

Responsibilities

Drive functional and technical delivery of key team and org-wide programs and initiatives.
Collaborate with engineering teams to design, scope, and shepherd features.
Create functional specs, project and release plans, and roadmaps.
Own and execute one or more software engineering programs simultaneously.
Drive product decisions that align with program and company objectives
Influence senior stakeholders and build consensus across engineering, product, and cross-functional teams
Define and scale program processes and frameworks that can be adopted across the org
Mentor TPMs and contribute to building the TPM discipline at Bridge

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

6+ years of experience in technical program or product management, with a consistent track record of shipping products with broad and global customer impact
You have a track record of providing solid program management during all phases of software development from kick-off to ship, demonstrating critical thinking and thought leadership throughout.
You're not satisfied with just delivering programs on time—you're discerning about product and infrastructure architecture and can lead technical discussions. You don’t let problems remain ambiguous and directly drive clarity on decision tradeoffs and solutions.
You operate independently and lead efforts across multiple teams and functions, with stakeholders in different disciplines across time zones.
You have strong written and verbal communication skills to build relationships and collaborate with diverse cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience at a fintech or payments company. Track record of driving programs with cross-organizational or company-wide impact — not just team-level delivery. Comfortable working directly with senior engineering and product leadership with limited support. History of building toward durable, long-term solutions, not just shipping on time.

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

The annual US base salary range for this role is $208,200 - $312,200. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Global Partner Engineering and Operations (PE&O) team is a vital part of Stripe’s Global Partnerships organization, playing a key role in our overall success. We manage the technical and operational dimensions of new and existing strategic product partnerships and programs. Positioned at the nexus of product development, engineering, and partnerships, we facilitate seamless collaboration essential for supporting Stripe’s rapid growth.

Our team is a diverse mix of technical and business professionals dedicated to executing operations with financial ecosystem partners. Additionally, the PE&O team initiates partner-agnostic programs and solutions to tackle broad ecosystem challenges, developing tools that enhance operational efficiency and scalability.

In This Role

The team is establishing a new function to oversee Card Network Compliance. In this position, you will be responsible for developing programs and processes to address Stripe’s card network changes and their implications for both Stripe and its users. This role is crucial for ensuring we stay informed about ongoing card network announcements, enhancing our strategic position, and driving operational efficiency in response to changes.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute significantly to building a function from the ground up and to help formulate strategies that align with the best interests of Stripe and its users!

Notre rôle est d’assurer la robustesse, la sécurité et l’évolutivité des systèmes qui permettent à Decathlon de livrer ses clients partout dans le monde. Nous travaillons main dans la main avec les équipes métiers et nos fournisseurs pour garantir disponibilité, performance et innovation.

Nous te proposons de travailler sur la partie RÉSEAU en début d’alternance afin de développer tes compétences en réseau qui te seront utiles à l’interconnexion de nos mécanisations en entrepôts. Ensuite et seulement après une période de probation réussie sur le réseau, tu pourras évoluer au sein du pôle PARTNERS afin de prendre en charge des partenaires de mécanisation, ce qui te permettra de développer des compétences en gestion de projet, en sécurité et réseau !

Ton rôle au sein du pôle RÉSEAU

Gérer le support IT, la résolution d’incidents et l’optimisation des performances.
Optimiser la performance et la sécurité du réseau de nos entrepôts.
Monitorer nos équipements réseau.
Participer à des projets stratégiques de déploiement de nouvelles solutions IT.
Rédiger et mettre à jour la documentation technique.
Travailler dans un environnement international et collaboratif.

Ton rôle au sein de le pôle PARTNERS

Intégré e à l’équipe INFRALOG, tu contribueras à la fiabilité et la sécurité de notre infrastructure IT pour assurer un fonctionnement optimal des mécanisations de nos entrepôts logistiques DECATHLON, dont l’impact business est critique pour notre supply chain.

🖥️ Ton environnement technique :

Tu évolueras au sein d’un environnement riche et varié, comprenant notamment :

🔹 Gestion fournisseurs :
suivi de contrats, animation de comités techniques, coordination avec partenaires externes

🔹 Réseau

outils de ticketing et monitoring, gestion d’incidents

🔹 Documentation & partage :
wiki interne, bonnes pratiques, procédures techniques.

🔹 Méthodologies :
gestion de projet, gestion de crise, suivi de DRP.

Tes missions

Au sein du pôle Partners
de l’équipe INFRALOG, tu contribueras à :

DESIGN & ARCHITECTURE (Construire)

Pilotage des Partenaires de Mécanisation : Tu es l'interlocuteur technique privilégié de nos partenaires (Exotec, TGW, Dematic, Falcon) pour garantir le maintien en condition opérationnelle (MCO) de leurs solutions. Tu animes le suivi de nos KPI.
Humain : Tu établis/maintiens une relation de confiance avec nos partenaires
Challenger et concevoir les architectures : Tu définis et valides les solutions d'interconnexion (LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, MPLS) entre le réseau Decathlon et les écosystèmes partenaires mécanisés. Tu t'assures que leur design s'intègre parfaitement à nos standards (Cisco, Meraki).
Audit technique : Tu qualifies les architectures proposées par les nouvelles mécanisations avant leur déploiement mondial.
Piloter les projets techniques : Tu orchestres la partie Infra/Réseau lors des ouvertures de sites, extensions ou rétrofits. Tu es le garant technique du succès des nouvelles installations.

MAINTENANCE & RÉSILIENCE (Faire durer)

Garantir la haute disponibilité : Ton objectif est clair : 0 incident critique. Tu t'assures que les solutions partenaires sont robustes et performantes au quotidien.
Piloter les Plans de Reprise d'Activité (DRP) : Tu organises et supervises les tests de résilience (bascule réseau, crash tests) avec les partenaires pour garantir que les mécanisations ne s'arrêtent jamais.
Maîtriser l'obsolescence : Tu gères le cycle de vie du matériel et des logiciels (Life Cycle Management) pour éviter la dette technique et les pannes évitables.
Gérer les situations de crise : En cas d'incident majeur, tu gardes la tête froide. Tu pilotes la cellule de crise avec les partenaires, les entrepôts et les équipes internes concernées pour rétablir le service au plus vite et limiter l'impact sur nos entrepôts.

SÉCURITÉ & CONFORMITÉ (Protéger)

Sécurisation (Security by Design) les flux et les accès : Tu assures la mise en conformité des solutions partenaires (segmentation réseau, déploiement du SSO, gestion d’identité sur les interfaces WCS) pour protéger nos flux contre les cyber-menaces.
Auditer et corriger : Tu contrôles régulièrement le niveau de sécurité des installations partenaires et pilotes les plans de remédiation en cas de vulnérabilité détectée.

PROXIMITÉ (Le contact)

Incarner la culture "Terrain" : Parce que la réalité se vit en entrepôt, des déplacements réguliers sont à prévoir (France et international) pour rencontrer les équipes locales et maintenir un lien fort avec nos collègues en entrepôts.

Tu as des fortes appétences en réseau et infrastructure (la connaissance des environnements logistiques est un plus).
Une réelle appétence pour la Sécurité. Tu as le réflexe de penser "protection des données" et "sécurité des accès" dans chaque projet.
Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais (B2 minimum) pour échanger quotidiennement avec nos partenaires internationaux.
Une communication fluide, de l'autonomie, de la rigueur et une capacité à garder son sang-froid (gestion de crise).
Une forte appétence pour le travail collaboratif, l'entraide et la volonté d’apprendre en continu.

.

⚡ Une culture du sport et de l’innovation

de nos produits et rejoins nos équipes sportives !

DECATHLON DIGITAL

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon.
Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Manage a portfolio of projects representing approximately $10M–$25M+ in annual revenue with full responsibility for profitability, forecasting, and cost control.

Identify scope changes early and manage pricing, negotiation, and approval of change orders while ensuring contract compliance and protecting company interests.

Other duties as assigned.

Title:
Senior Engineering Project Manager

Company:
Heven AeroTech

Location:
Bingen, Washington

FLSA:
Exempt

About Our Company

At Heven AeroTech (Heven), we don’t just believe in the power of people—we build our success on it. As a recognized leader in hydrogen-powered drones, we’ve earned recognition for creating a workplace where innovation thrives, collaboration is second nature, and every employee feels valued. Our culture is anchored in trust and a shared commitment to excellence.

We believe great teams are built on individuals who are humble, hungry, and smart—those who put team success first, take initiative to continuously improve, and demonstrate strong interpersonal awareness. At Heven, your voice matters, your ideas are heard, and your contributions make a tangible impact as you grow through hands-on experience and collaboration across the team.

Role Summary

Heven AeroTech is seeking a Senior Engineering Project Manager to plan, coordinate, and drive the technical execution of our unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) engineering programs. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and program management: you will own the integrated technical schedule, translate systems engineering and design requirements into executable work plans, and keep multidisciplinary engineering teams (airframe, propulsion, avionics, software, and payload) aligned against cost, schedule, and technical performance targets. Beyond running individual programs, you will build and continuously improve the engineering project management processes, tools, and gating criteria that the broader organization uses to deliver UAS hardware and software from concept through flight test and production. Success in this role requires genuine technical fluency — the ability to read requirements and drawings, understand test data, and engage credibly in engineering design reviews — combined with strong program management discipline.

Essential Responsibilities

Lead technical project management for one or more UAS engineering programs, spanning airframe/structures, propulsion, avionics, flight software, and payload integration workstreams.
Develop and maintain the integrated master schedule (IMS), work breakdown structure (WBS), and critical path analysis; proactively identify schedule risk and drive recovery plans.
Partner with systems engineering to translate requirements, interface control documents, and verification plans into actionable engineering task plans and staffing assignments.
Plan and facilitate technical design reviews and program milestones (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, flight readiness reviews), including agenda development, entrance/exit criteria, and action item tracking to closure.
Own program-level technical risk and opportunity management: identify, quantify, track, and drive mitigation of engineering risks in coordination with discipline leads.
Manage engineering change requests and configuration control in support of the company's design change (PDCR) process, ensuring changes are scoped, reviewed, and communicated to affected teams.
Develop, standardize, and continuously improve engineering project management processes, templates, and tools (scheduling, requirements traceability, risk registers, metrics/dashboards) across programs.
Manage program technical budget and resource allocation; support staffing plans and headcount forecasting in coordination with engineering leads.
Coordinate with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and test/flight operations to ensure engineering deliverables support build, integration, and flight test schedules.
Interface directly with internal leadership and external customers/partners to communicate technical status, risks, and trade-offs; prepare and deliver program reviews and status reporting.
Support compliance with applicable engineering standards, airworthiness, and regulatory requirements (e.g., FAA Part 107/UAS regulations, relevant MIL-STD or RTCA/DO guidance) as they apply to program execution.
Drive lessons-learned capture and process retrospectives at program milestones to feed continuous improvement of engineering execution practices.
Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written) is required to perform the responsibilities of this role.
This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.
If this role requires access to information controlled under U.S. export control laws (ITAR/EAR), applicants must also qualify as a "U.S. person" under 22 CFR
120.62 (U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee).
Other duties as assigned.

Required

Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
4–10 years of experience in engineering project management, technical program management, or systems engineering, ideally within UAS, aerospace, or defense product development.
Demonstrated technical fluency: able to read and interpret engineering drawings, requirements documents, interface control documents, and test/analysis data well enough to plan work and challenge technical assumptions.
Proven experience building and maintaining integrated schedules (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet) and work breakdown structures for multidisciplinary hardware/software programs.
Experience managing technical risk registers, action item tracking, and design review gating (PDR/CDR-type milestones).
Track record of developing or improving engineering project management processes, templates, or tools within an organization.
Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting technical status to engineering leadership and customers.
Working knowledge of configuration management and engineering change control processes.

Preferred

Master's degree in an engineering discipline or a technical MBA.
PMP, PgMP, or equivalent project/program management certification.
Direct experience on UAS, drone, or other aerospace/defense flight vehicle programs.
Familiarity with systems engineering lifecycle practices (requirements management, V&V/test planning, MBSE tools).
Experience with PLM/ALM tooling (e.g., Windchill, Teamcenter, Jira, Confluence) and requirements management tools (e.g., DOORS, Jama).
Familiarity with FAA UAS regulations, airworthiness processes, or relevant military/commercial aviation standards (e.g., DO-178C, DO-160, MIL-STD-810).
Experience with earned value management (EVM) or similar program performance metrics

Physical Requirements

Ability to work in both office and engineering lab environments for extended periods.
Ability to sit, stand, walk, and use a computer for prolonged periods throughout the workday.
Ability to occasionally lift and carry up to 25 pounds of engineering equipment, prototypes, test hardware, or program materials.
Ability to attend and participate in engineering design reviews, manufacturing floor activities, integration events, and flight test operations.
Ability to travel domestically up to 20% of the time, with occasional international travel as required.
Ability to access manufacturing, test, and flight operations environments, including navigating hangars, workshops, and outdoor test sites.
Ability to visually inspect engineering drawings, schedules, technical documentation, hardware, and test data.
Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and through virtual collaboration tools.

Benefits Overview

Heven AeroTech offers a competitive benefits package designed to support the health, financial security, and overall well-being of our employees and their families. Benefits in protectional, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans, paid time off/sick, and additional protections such as critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident coverage, and short- and long-term disability.

Heven AeroTech is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

new_jobs.title: Senior Humanitarian Access Safety and Security Manager
new_jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

Job Overview

The Senior Humanitarian Access, Safety & Security Manager (SHASSM) supports safe, effective and efficient access to and by people in need of humanitarian assistance. The role reports to the Senior HASS Coordinator and supports field locations in implementing programs aligned with the IRC’s risk appetite and strong commitment to the safety and security of our staff. The Snr HASSM ensures access and security risks are identified on time, mitigations are implemented, and staff are appropriately briefed on the security risk environment, relevant SOPs and Contingency Plans. The role will have a strong focus on providing capacity building to the Humanitarian Access, Safety & Security teams in each Field location. The Snr HASSM will also cover gaps in the HASS team in field locations and deputize for the Senior HASS Coordinator when requested.

Key Responsibilities

Humanitarian Access Management

Identify barriers to access and support the HASS and program teams in developing mitigation strategies.
Provide technical support to program teams in assessing the suitability of establishing operations in new locations
Develop relationships with local authorities as needed and other power brokers within IRC’s implementation areas.
Promote and support the integration of humanitarian access approaches into program design and implementation.
Constantly monitor available sources to collect, compile and report information to the Senior HASS Coordinator including incidents and trends pertinent to humanitarian access in areas of operations
Support key field management teams to develop and implement community engagement strategies that promote acceptance and access.
Support the Senior HASS Coordinator to ensure that IRC’s visibility strategy and profile support principled humanitarian access.

Safety and Security Risk Management

Provide technical support to the field offices and program teams on all policies, procedures, guidelines and planning for staff safety, and program continuity in Ukraine.
Contribute to the development of and updating of Security Risk Assessments (SRA) for field sites.
Contribute to the development and updating of Field Security Management Plans (SMP), including all associated contingency plans and SOPs.
Monitor the rollout and implementation of SOPs and contingency plans at a field level ensuring compliance.
Ensure effective security risk management plans for cross-border access to field sites, principally through border crossings to/from Moldova.
Ensure contingency plans for hibernation, relocation, and evacuation are known to ield staff and exercise regularly.
Ensure that all program locations and routes are routinely assessed by the HASS team to identify access and security risks in a timely manner.
Ensure all field locations meet requirements for safety and security supplies and equipment including hibernation kits, first aid kits and emergency communications.
Ensure the emergency warden systems in field locations are fit-for-purpose and tested regularly.
As requested by field teams, conduct risk assessments in new geographic locations identified for program implementation.
Deploy alongside program teams to high-risk areas and establish deployment protocols commensurate to the risk assessed.
Conduct field visits to all IRC field offices and cover HASS teams gaps when requested.
Deputize the Senior Humanitarian Access, Safety & Security Coordinator as requested.
Demonstrated experience operating at a senior / strategic level with the ability to deputize for and cover the most senior in-country security role

Capacity Building

Liaise with the HASSM to jointly draft the annual capacity building plan based on the key risks faced by frontline staff.
Support the delivery of training to field staff; deliver trainings as needed and relevant.
Support the Senior HASS Coordinator to identify the capacity-building needs of the HASS team based on the needed capacities and skills to ensure safe, secure and principled humanitarian access.
Provide on-the-job capacity building for the HASS team through mentoring, coaching, and guidance.
Support the HASS team to strengthen and expand the capacity of field teams to prepare and respond in a timely manner to emerging emergencies
Support the HASS team to deliver staff awareness and training sessions.
Support the Senior HASS Coordinator to develop and deliver training on Critical Incident Management.
In coordination with the Senior HASS Coordinator, develop a plan to promote national talent within the team to assume more responsibility.

Context Monitoring and Reporting

Monitor open sources and available information to identify changes in the context of heightened tensions.
Support the Senior HASS Coordinator in ensuring field teams are appropriately advised of the risk environment, and preparedness actions are implemented.
Support the HASS team to compile regular context updates to monitor issues that could impact program delivery.
Work closely with the HASS team to ensure all incidents and accidents are reported on IRC’s online system within 48 hours of the incident occurring.
Support the Senior HASS Coordinator in scenario planning exercises.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS

Reports to: Senior Humanitarian Access, Safety and Security Coordinator

Supervises:
None.

Key Internal Relationships: HASS Manager, HASS Officers and Assistants, Field Coordinators

Key External Relationships: Local partners, INGOs operating in field locations, Security and Access Working Groups, local authorities and stakeholders relevant to program delivery

Requirements

Job Requirements

Work Experience

A University degree in a subject relevant to humanitarian action or security such as International Relations or Political Science.
Minimum of 5 years humanitarian safety, security and access management experience with an INGO, including demonstrated capability in planning, organizing and executing security operations in the field.
Demonstrated security leadership skills including operating independently with limited oversight. This role is a senior-level experienced and independent contributor.
Demonstrated experience managing safety, security and humanitarian access across multiple high-risk or conflict-affected country contexts is required Strong understanding of the humanitarian principles required.
Demonstrated experience negotiating and expanding humanitarian access in active conflict / frontline environments Knowledge of communications technology including satellite communications.
Strong experience as a trainer.
Ability to provide dynamic verbal and written briefings on short notice.
Able to express ideas and concepts clearly and persuasively to internal and external stakeholders.
Exceptional organizational and coordination skills
Excellent relationship-building, interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively represent IRC at forums and with external stakeholders
Experience working successfully with local stakeholders such as local and international NGOs and government with sensitivity and diplomacy.
Knowledge of GIS and Google Earth is desirable.

Languages Required/Preferred

Fluency in English required.

Ability To Travel

This role requires at least 40% travel within Ukraine and therefore will not be suitable for applicants that are not willing or able to deploy to field locations regularly.

Professional Standards:
All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

Cookies: https://careers.rescue.org/us/en/cookiesettings

Promote a culture of collaboration and transparency with crew, yard staff, contractors, and suppliers that actively supports awareness and implementation of continual improvement at all stages of the docking process

Provide subject mater expertise and own witness input to subsequent investigations, ensuring learning and improvement opportunities are maximised for V.Dockings and V.Group, overall

Collaborating with Group, Business Unit, and Operational teams to drive safe operations in dry-docks
Ensuring consistent and efficient dockings for V.Ships and 3rd parties, in line with V.Dockings processes
Professional representation of V. at all times to customers and external stakeholders
Continually reinforcing collaboration and close working relationships between V.Group and V.Ships teams

Essential

Proven experience in Dry Dock Specification and Tender writing, review, and analysis
Excellent ability to make, maintain, and grow customer relations with key internal and external stakeholders

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
