new_jobs.title: Program Manager – Defense Programs
new_jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Program Manager will lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex Department of Defense (DoD) programs and contracts. This leadership-level position is responsible for ensuring programs are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with customer requirements and organizational objectives.

The Program Manager will work closely with senior military leaders, government customers, industry partners, and internal leadership to drive program execution, operational excellence, and business growth. This role will play a key part in supporting our company growth strategy toward $200M-$300M in annual revenue
, with visibility into a $750M-$1B opportunity pipeline
.

Candidates with strong industry-side defense program management experience
are preferred over candidates whose experience is primarily on the U.S. Government side. Navy program experience is highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Program Planning & Execution

Develop and manage comprehensive program plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, and performance objectives.
Define program scope, requirements, timelines, and resource needs.
Coordinate resources across manufacturing, facilities, supply chain, engineering, and operations.
Support proposals, statements of work, specifications, pricing, and contractual requirements.
Drive program execution from initial planning through successful delivery.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

Build strong relationships with senior military leaders, government representatives, prime contractors, and industry partners.
Serve as a trusted customer-facing leader and primary point of contact for program execution.
Communicate program status, risks, milestones, and performance to internal and external stakeholders.
Manage customer expectations and proactively resolve issues.
Ensure all contractual deliverables and commitments are achieved.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Lead cross-functional program teams and establish clear roles, responsibilities, priorities, and accountability.
Coordinate activities across operations, manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, facilities, and other functional areas.
Foster collaboration and quickly resolve issues or conflicts affecting program performance.
Provide direction, coaching, and support to project team members.
Lead program management reviews, executive briefings, progress reports, and customer presentations.

Budget & Cost Management

Develop, manage, and monitor program budgets.
Track labor, materials, overhead, subcontractor, and other program-related costs.
Monitor financial performance and take corrective action when necessary.
Ensure efficient utilization of resources while maintaining program profitability.

Risk Management

Identify, assess, and prioritize program risks and opportunities.
Develop and implement mitigation and contingency strategies.
Maintain active risk registers and monitor risks throughout the program lifecycle.
Escalate critical issues and develop timely corrective actions.

Compliance, Governance & Quality

Ensure programs comply with contractual, organizational, DoD, ITAR, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Support CMMC readiness and compliance initiatives.
Establish and maintain effective program governance and quality-control processes.
Monitor program performance and address quality or compliance issues promptly.

Change Management

Evaluate and manage changes to program scope, schedule, cost, resources, and requirements.
Document and communicate approved changes to all affected stakeholders.
Assess the impact of changes and develop mitigation plans to minimize disruption.

Strategic Leadership

Serve as a leadership-level Program Manager with direct visibility to our executive leadership team.
Contribute to long-term business and program growth strategies.
Lead rapid program ramp-up and expansion efforts.
Integrate manufacturing, facilities, supply chain, and operations into overall program execution.
Develop long-term relationships with strategic suppliers and industry partners.
Apply industry best practices to strengthen supply chain performance and program delivery.

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve program execution, operational efficiency, cost, quality, and delivery.
Apply Lean Six Sigma methodologies to drive measurable improvements.
Continuously evaluate processes and implement best practices across programs.
A Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt is a plus.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, technical training, and professional experience.
PMP, PgMP, or equivalent program/project management certification required.
10+ years of progressive Program Management experience within the DoD/defense industry.
Demonstrated experience managing large-scale defense programs and contracts at the $100M+ level.
Strong preference for industry-side defense program management experience.
Navy program experience strongly preferred.
Proven ability to manage complex defense contracts, deliverables, schedules, budgets, and customer requirements.
Experience working directly with senior military leaders and government customers.
Strong understanding of defense manufacturing, supply chain, and operational environments.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office, including MS Project.
ERP system experience is beneficial.
Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.

Core Competencies

Defense Program & Contract Management
Program Planning & Execution
DoD/Navy Program Experience
Budget & Cost Management
Risk & Change Management
Customer & Executive Relationship Management
Manufacturing & Supply Chain Integration
Cross-Functional Leadership
Program Governance & Compliance
Lean Six Sigma / Continuous Improvement
Strategic Planning & Business Growth
Executive Communication & Presentation Skills

Supervisory Responsibility

This position does not have direct supervisory responsibility but will provide leadership and direction to cross-functional program teams.

Work Environment

Primarily office-based with standard physical requirements.
Occasional standing, walking, and use of hands and arms may be required.
Must have sufficient visual acuity to work with documents and computer screens.

Schedule

Full-time | Monday-Thursday | 7:00 a.m.-5:30 p.m.

Travel

Minimal travel is expected.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a senior defense-industry Program Manager
who has successfully led $100M+ DoD programs
, preferably within the Navy
, and is comfortable operating at both the executive and customer level. This individual should combine strong program execution skills with commercial awareness, manufacturing and supply chain expertise, and the ability to operate in a fast-growing organization.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on leader who can take ownership, drive accountability, solve complex problems, build customer trust, and scale programs rapidly while maintaining cost, schedule, quality, and contractual performance.

Project Manager – Audio Visual / Multimedia

Location:
Mumbai, India

Employment Type:
Permanent / Full-Time

Work Arrangement:
Client Location – Mumbai

Experience:
7–10+ years

Function:
Technology Project Management / Audio Visual & Multimedia

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Technology Project Manager – Audio Visual / Multimedia
to manage the full project lifecycle for the design, implementation, deployment, testing and commissioning of premium Audio-Visual (AV) and multimedia-enabled spaces for a global corporate across the Asia Pacific region.

The role will manage projects ranging from standard conference rooms to complex multi-purpose spaces, studios, executive/client conferencing areas and other integrated technology environments. The successful candidate will have strong hands-on experience in AV technology, project delivery, vendor management, stakeholder engagement, budgeting and commissioning of complex AV solutions.

The position is based at the client location in Mumbai
and requires the ability to collaborate effectively with global, regional and local stakeholders while delivering projects within defined timelines, budgets and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

Needs Analysis, Budgeting & Approvals
Receive and manage AV project assignments across the Asia Pacific region.
Initiate projects in collaboration with Real Estate Project Management and relevant business teams.
Gather and document client, business and Line of Business requirements.
Review architect and interior designer test-fit drawings for room types, quantities, layouts and AV requirements.
Develop AV solution markups on floor plans to clearly communicate proposed solutions to management, stakeholders and clients.
Apply global and regional standard AV room solutions to floor and room plans.
Work closely with senior AV and Engineering teams for solution reviews and technical support.
Obtain quotations from qualified AV integration partners.
Develop high-level project cost estimates, resource requirements and Statements of Work based on client requirements and AV standards.
Manage project approvals and raise requisitions/orders through Ariba.
Maintain regular, documented weekly project status updates.
Design, Vendor Engagement & Procurement
Lead project kick-off meetings with AV vendor Project Managers and ensure alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and requirements.
For custom or complex projects, develop comprehensive RFP packages, including drawings, Bill of Materials, project schedules and other relevant documentation.
Coordinate with Sourcing teams to initiate and manage the procurement process through Ariba.
Engage approved AV vendor partners and coordinate the bidding process.
Review bid leveling, commercial proposals and auction processes with Regional Heads and peer teams.
Evaluate best and final pricing in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
Coordinate kick-off meetings with awarded vendors and formally launch new engagements.
Coordinate site access, permits and other requirements for vendor surveys and project execution.
Implementation, Testing & Commissioning
Manage the complete AV implementation lifecycle from vendor quotation through Purchase Order, deployment, testing and commissioning.
Ensure vendor commitments, Purchase Orders and MSA schedules are adhered to.
Develop detailed AV project schedules covering all key milestones and dependencies.
Share project plans with Operations Leads and coordinate resource/support planning.
Integrate AV schedules with broader construction schedules and overall project plans.
Prepare project presentations and status materials for management and client stakeholders.
Obtain detailed AV asset inventories from AV vendors/hardware distributors, including serial numbers and MAC addresses.
Collate and manage subnet and network information.
For Digital Signage deployments, create Digital Signage Narratives using the approved internal template and coordinate review/approval with Regional and Corporate Communications teams.
Coordinate Digital Signage deployment schedules and calendar invitations with Corporate Communications stakeholders.
Manage AV vendors and deployment activities throughout the project lifecycle.
Monitor project budgets, costs, risks and change control.
Conduct jobsite inspections to ensure deployment progress, workmanship and quality meet defined standards.
Attend and lead internal and external project meetings as required.
Maintain accurate and current project information in the Project Tracker across the entire portfolio.
Keep regional Operations Leads informed of project progress, risks, delays, technology changes and other challenges.
Provision Telepresence/Unified Communications endpoints using approved Microsoft Teams and Zoom portal capabilities.
Provision Digital Signage endpoints using the current approved software platform.
Provision IPTV endpoints using the current approved software platform.
Coordinate Operations walkthroughs, testing and handover activities with regional leads.
Coordinate End User Orientation/Training, typically delivered by Operations teams.
Project Closeout & Handover
Notify relevant peer groups upon successful project completion.
Update completed rooms to the appropriate Active status and submit required MACD documentation to Operations.
Collect and validate all final as-built drawings, DSP files, programming codes and AV asset information from vendors.
Ensure all final project documentation is stored correctly in the designated SharePoint project folder.
Manage approved/rejected project queues and progress projects toward formal closure.
Collect final vendor invoices and coordinate submission through Ariba for final payments.
Update the Project Tracker and move completed projects to the appropriate Completed status.
Ensure all project deliverables, technical documentation and handover requirements are fully completed before project closure.

Required Skills & Experience

7–10+ years of relevant experience in Technology Project Management, Audio Visual, Multimedia, AV Integration or related technology environments.
Strong experience managing the full lifecycle of AV projects, from requirements gathering and design through procurement, implementation, testing, commissioning and handover.
Hands-on understanding of premium/professional AV systems and integrated multimedia environments.
Experience designing, integrating, implementing or managing complex AV systems.
Strong understanding of AV control systems, programming and commissioning.
Experience managing conference rooms, multi-purpose spaces, studios, executive rooms, client conferencing environments and other integrated technology spaces.
Strong experience in vendor management, procurement, budgeting, project scheduling and change control.
Experience working with MNCs/global corporate environments is highly desirable.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work across regional and global teams.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work effectively under tight deadlines and pressure.
Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in project tracking, reporting and documentation.
Experience with procurement platforms such as Ariba is an advantage.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Digital Signage and IPTV platforms is preferred.

Mandatory Certification / Professional Affiliation

CTS (Certified Technology Specialist) accreditation is mandatory.
AVIXA affiliation/membership is mandatory.

Key Competencies

Audio Visual Technology & Integration
End-to-End Project Management
AV Design & Implementation
Testing & Commissioning
Vendor & Partner Management
Budget & Cost Management
Procurement & Contract Management
Stakeholder Management
Risk & Change Management
Project Scheduling & Execution
Client Management
Communication & Presentation Skills
Problem Solving
Attention to Detail
Ability to Work Under Pressure

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will consistently deliver AV and multimedia projects on time, within budget and to required quality standards
, while ensuring strong stakeholder communication, effective vendor management, seamless commissioning and complete project documentation and handover.

Interested?

Please share your updated resume with:

sarika.vinayak@neweratech.com

ruchitha.kalamarla@neweratech.com

new_jobs.title: Private Wealth Senior Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Position Overview

Neuberger Wealth is seeking a highly motivated and results-driven individual to lead initiatives focused on process improvement and operational excellence. This individual will play a critical role in enhancing the efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness of the Neuberger Wealth business by evaluating current processes, identifying opportunities for improvement, and driving implementation efforts. The role requires a blend of strategic thinking, operational expertise, and change management capabilities.

As a senior member of the Wealth Platforms & Experience organization, this role will be responsible for the ownership and execution of several strategic programs and analyses related to our Client and Advisor experiences. This includes activities related to the entirety of the client/account lifecycle, including everything from onboarding, maintenance, reporting, and experience, as well as their impact on Advisor tools and workflows.

Working closely with our Wealth Advisor Teams, as well as stakeholders from across the firm, this leader will advocate for a re-imagined platform that can deliver our future state capabilities for both Client and Advisor experiences.

Our choice candidate will be a detail oriented strategic thinker with a passion for solving complex problems, dealing with ambiguity, organizational design, and who possesses an unrelenting customer obsession and a strong desire to make their mark on the organization. The candidate will bring an experienced lens to analyze our current state and identify what could be integrated or improved further; while owning the implementation plan. We are looking for 12+ years of direct wealth management home office experience in roles across Operations or Business Architecture. This role is pivotal to the ongoing Private Wealth transformation, ensuring best-in-class experiences, digital enablement, and operational excellence.

Primary Responsibilities

new_jobs.description:
Overview

If you've spent time studying or working outside Japan and you're ready to put that global perspective to work, this role was built for you. Japan's IT services market is one of the most complex and distinctive in the world — and IDC needs analysts who can read it from the inside while connecting it to what's happening globally. That combination is rare, and it's exactly what makes this role compelling.

About The Role

This is an opportunity to shape how the world understands Japan's IT services market — and to do it from Tokyo, at the center of one of Asia-Pacific's most dynamic technology ecosystems.

As a Research Analyst on IDC Japan's Services team, you will lead original research on Japan's IT services landscape, with a particular focus on mid-tier vendors, system integrators, and domestic local vendors that define much of the market's character. You will contribute to two flagship IDC programs — the Japan Services CIS program and the Worldwide Semiannual Services Tracker — and collaborate closely with IDC's global and Asia-Pacific analyst network.

This role is well-suited for candidates who have pursued graduate education internationally and are ready to return to Japan to build a career at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and market intelligence. You will bring a global perspective to a market that is deeply local — and that combination is exactly what our clients need.

What You’ll Do

Research & Analysis

Lead ongoing research and analysis of Japan’s IT services market, with a focus on mid-tier vendors, system integrators, and local players
Develop market forecasts, vendor share analyses, and demand-side surveys of enterprise IT buyers
Conduct primary research including interviews with IT suppliers and user companies, web surveys, and secondary data analysis
Author high-quality research reports, market perspectives, and vendor assessments for IDC’s syndicated research services

Client Engagement & Business Development

Provide direct analyst support to mid-tier clients, translating research into actionable guidance
Support business development for cloud-related subscription and custom research services
Present at external industry events and IDC-hosted events on cloud and services market trends
Engage in consulting projects and deliver advisory services to technology vendors and buyers

Global Collaboration

Partner with IDC’s Asia-Pacific and global services analysts to contribute a Japanese market perspective to IDC’s worldwide thought leadership
Build and maintain relationships with services vendors and system integrators across Japan, especially in the mid-tier and local vendor segments

What You Bring

We’re looking for candidates who combine analytical rigor, IT market knowledge, and the ability to work fluently across Japanese and international business contexts. There is no single background that defines a strong candidate — we welcome applications from those who bring experience from different angles:

IT vendor, system integrator, or consulting firm experience: Background in system development, implementation support, IT solution marketing, or business planning, with solid knowledge of the IT market
Enterprise IT buyer experience: Experience selecting and implementing vendors or systems, or managing technology planning at a client organization, with knowledge of IT products and solutions
Analyst or research background: Experience conducting IT market research, competitive analysis, or technology advisory — particularly relevant for candidates transitioning from other analyst roles

Skills & Qualifications

Japanese: Native or near-native proficiency (reading, writing, and speaking) — required for client-facing research and vendor engagement in Japan
English: Business-level proficiency for collaboration with global IDC teams, international report writing, and external communications
Education: Bachelor’s degree required; graduate degree (MBA or equivalent) a strong plus, particularly for candidates with international academic experience who are returning to Japan
Analytical tools: Proficiency in Excel (including pivot tables and data modeling), PowerPoint, and Word
Curiosity & rigor: Genuine interest in technology markets, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, compelling insights

Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

This is an ongoing talent pipeline posting. We review applications on a rolling basis and extend offers as strong candidates are identified and business needs are confirmed. Submitting your application does not guarantee an immediate opening — but it ensures your profile is considered as opportunities become available. We will reach out if your background is a strong match.

What We Offer

Individualized Culture: An environment where you can explore new areas outside your specialty and stay engaged with work you enjoy.
Hybrid Working: Hybrid working with certain days in office per week/month required. (Depends on Team)
Time-off and holidays: On top of your statutory holiday allowance and public holidays, IDC grants annually reviewed company-wide closures on 19 August (Unplug Day) and 24 December – 1 January inclusive (Global Shutdown) and a volunteering day.
A position in a highly professional and globally respected market research and advisory firm, where initiative leading to results is rewarded.

Credit views on this bank's covered issuers currently rely on periodic reviews that go stale between rating cycles, and a global bank standing up its India technology and operations centre has partnered with Flexiple to hire a Credit Research Analyst who will keep those views current on its India credit research desk.
The desk you'd support

This desk covers a portfolio of corporate and financial issuers, tracking their credit profile, capital structure and covenant headroom, and feeding that analysis into the rating views and internal credit opinions used across lending, trading and risk functions. The work sits close to real decisions: a stale credit view here can show up as a mispriced position or a missed covenant breach somewhere else in the bank.
How a rating call gets made

Building and maintaining financial models for covered issuers, including leverage, coverage and liquidity metrics
Tracking covenant compliance, rating actions and credit events across the assigned portfolio
Drafting credit notes and issuer updates that summarise financial performance against thesis and triggers
Supporting senior analysts on new issuer onboarding, including first-pass credit write-ups
Monitoring macro, sector and regulatory developments that could move an issuer's credit profile

What we're looking for in a first read

2 to 6 years of experience in credit research, corporate ratings, fixed income research or related credit analysis, with strong financial modelling skills and comfort reading financial statements, indentures and credit agreements. You should be able to write a credit note that a senior analyst can sign off on with minimal rework, and be precise about assumptions in a leverage or coverage model.
Where the seat sits

The role is based out of Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad or Pune, or Remote (India), working alongside a global credit research function with regular touchpoints across time zones.
After you apply

The process includes an HR Screening, a modelling or case assignment, a Technical Round with the credit team and a final Culture Fit conversation. One application here covers this opening and any other Flexiple-matched role that fits your experience, so there is no need to reapply.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. We’re working a minimum of 4 days a week onsite as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary. 

Medtronic's Acute Care & Monitoring (ACM)
business works together with the global healthcare community to solve clinically meaningful problems, with technologies and solutions for remote patient monitoring, blood oxygen management, respiratory compromise, and perioperative complications. Our vision is to empower patient safety - anytime, anywhere.

In the role as Business Analyst
, you will work with the Digital Health Product Owner and Product Design team to advance existing technology or introduce new technology and therapies.
You will work with key stakeholders to understand needs, and define and deliver prioritized features in the feature backlog
. Additionally, you will be responsible for building tight collaboration and a culture of trust within the Digital Health organization
. The Business Analyst will also collaborate closely with the Product Owner
for management and synthesis of needs to features for delivery in a release
.

Responsibilities Include:

Accountable for intake of needs from the Product Owner and closely connecting with the Product Owner and Marketing to understand the value and problem to solve.
Responsible for deep engagement with the customer to understand the needs being presented and subsequently, build the desired behavior of the features based on the customer feedback
Translate large business goals into small, clear tasks and user stories for the Product Design team.
Connect with the Product Owner and Marketing to ensure agile releases are continually building the right things and building them right.
Apply a customer-centric mindset along with design thinking tools to deliver solutions that are desirable, viable, feasible and sustainable.
Understand from the Product Owner the themes prioritized, vision, product roadmap and definition of quantified value
Identify the problem to be solved. Identifying problems that customers want to be solved is the first element of design thinking.
Responsible for managing the technical backlog and working ahead to have detailed requirements defined and groomed with the team.
Collaborate with the architects to define technical and design discovery required for a feature
Gather detailed functional and non-functional specifications through workshops, interviews, and data analysis.
Analyze current business workflows, system interfaces, and operational gaps to recommend solutions.
Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flow diagrams for the development team.
Intake input/feedback/insights from customers, stakeholders, and the scrum team and understand the needs around the voices to evaluate value accordingly and make an informed decision
Collaborate with Product Owner to ensure solutions are understood and aligned to features that need to be developed
Collaborate with UI/UX Designer to ensure design meets customer needs
Help Digital Health portfolio innovate digital solutions in the medical and home care space by engaging Systems thinking.
Organizational collaborator on Digital Health enabled initiatives to leverage cross disciplinary and globally distributed teams to craft high-quality products and services that customers love and drive preference
Collaborate with other leaders to ensure successful development, release, and launch of world-class product (portfolio/program)

Minimum Qualifications (Must Have):

Bachelor's Degree plus 2+ years experience in systems, digital, or software development.

Preferred Qualifications:

5+ years experience in systems, digital or software development with proven track record.
Experience in the medical device industry or other regulated product industry
Knowledge of the Agile methodology.
Experience in 5+ major product or portfolio releases.
Ability to quickly understand complex system behaviors, engineering problems, technical and architectural constraints.
Excellent verbal and written and communication skills with an aptitude for convincing others, both internally and externally, of the value of their ideas.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R.

214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

new_jobs.description:
Our Mission and Opportunity

Early education is one of the most important determinants of childhood outcomes, a critical support for working families, and a $175B market that remains underserved by modern technology. Brightwheel is the largest, fastest growing, and most loved platform in early ed, trusted by millions of educators and families every day. We are a three-time Cloud 100 company, backed by top investors including Addition, Bessemer, Emerson Collective, Lowercase Capital, Notable Capital, and Mark Cuban.

Our Team

Our team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. We embody our Leadership Principles in our work and culture. We are a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally.

Who You Are

You are a highly analytical and technically proficient Senior Data Analyst
with a proven track record of using data to inform decision-making in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. As a natural problem-solver, you excel at translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You've played a key role supporting the analytics function in a high-growth environment at a prior company, leveraging AI
to drive business outcomes.

You are a generalist at heart — equally comfortable partnering with Finance to reconcile operating and financial views, standing up reporting for external partners, and stitching the full customer lifecycle into a single narrative for leadership. You've earned the trust of leadership and external stakeholders by holding a high bar for accuracy.

What You’ll Do

You are primarily responsible for Finance and Post-Sales analytics — owning the reporting layer that bridges Sales and Post-Sales, and producing the board-ready and externally-facing reporting our leadership team and government partners depend on.
Partner directly with Finance and senior leadership to build, validate, and own the metrics that feed board reporting, AOP planning, and monthly/quarterly business reviews — including MRR/ARR, churn and retention, and revenue attribution across customer segments.
Serve as the connective tissue between Sales and Post-Sales reporting, building a consistent view of the customer lifecycle from pipeline through activation, retention, and expansion, and resolving definitional gaps between the two.
Own our external partnership reporting portfolio end-to-end, including customer-facing dashboards — translating partner data requirements into models and dashboards, and ensuring the data we hand to an external audience is accurate, appropriately permissioned, and self-service.
Build, automate, and maintain dashboards and reports in our BI tools (Sigma + Tableau) to track key cross-funnel KPIs for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

What You’ve Done

4+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a relevant technical role — preferably with Finance, Fintech, BizOps, or Retention domain experience.
Advanced proficiency in core technical analytics, including SQL (writing complex queries and manipulating data), Data Transformation (maintaining data models with tools like dbt), and Business Intelligence/Visualization with tools like Sigma or Tableau.
Demonstrated experience in creating and maintaining data models and pipelines end-to-end that served as the single source of truth.
A history of building and owning a suite of dashboards and reports in a BI tool, consistently delivering valuable insights to business stakeholders.
Excellent communication skills for stakeholder management, including acting as a trusted consultant and effectively translating technical information for all levels of an organization.
Demonstrated fluency using AI to fundamentally change how you work — not just to speed up tasks, but to automate routine workflows, accelerate analyses, and build reusable tools and data infrastructure.
Bonus: Experience with Salesforce.

This role must be available for work during standard US working hours (any 8-hour shift from 9am EST - 8pm EST).

Brightwheel is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

addresses, and we never ask for payment or sensitive personal data as part of our hiring process. If you suspect fraudulent contact, reach out to security@mybrightwheel.com
. Thank you for helping us keep our applicant community safe.

new_jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position Reports To

Global Head of Sustainability

In our new Robotics company, you will strengthen Sustainability’s analytical backbone by building data models, templates, and dashboards that measure performance across climate, circularity, waste, water, energy and materials. You will help set up efficient tools and methods (Power BI, Excel, shared templates), ensure data quality, and enable clear insights for decision‑making across the business. You will also help digitalize and automate our processes, strengthen analytics and decision-making.

This role is part of ABB’s Robotics business, it bridges IT and sustainability, requiring someone who can code, communicate, and think strategically about data governance.

By joining us now, you’ll be part of a dynamic and fast-paced organization at the forefront of robotics innovation. As we transition into a separate entity outside the ABB Group, you’ll have the chance to shape the future, grow your career, and work alongside world-class experts in a more agile and entrepreneurial environment.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

This is a global role; the preferred locations are: Krakow or Västerås, with flexibility for the right candidate

Your Responsibilities

Build Enterprise Analytics Solutions – Develop and maintain scalable dashboards and reports using Power BI, Excel, Snowflake, and Streamlit that track Scope 1–3 emissions, circularity, waste, water, energy, and key sustainability KPIs with advanced data modelling and interactive visualizations
Standardize Data Frameworks & Templates – Design and implement reusable data collection processes, templates, and standards across Sustainability, Operations, Supply Chain, HR, Finance, and R&D to ensure consistency, quality, and audit readiness
Bridge IT & Sustainability – Translate sustainability business needs into data requirements; collaborate with IS/IT on toolchain decisions, connectors, and data infrastructure while representing the sustainability perspective
Ensure Data Integrity & Governance – Set up efficient validation, transformation, and refresh cycles; document calculation rules and assumptions; run quality checks to maintain audit-ready datasets and reliable decision-making
Enable Trend Analysis & Insights – Support topic leads with ad hoc analyses, scenario modelling (e.g., decarbonization pathways), and performance dashboards that drive strategy and accountability across the business

Essential Skills

Qualifications for the role:

Baschelors/ Masters degree in Data/Analytics, Engineering, Sustainability or a related field
 3–5 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics consulting
Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, data warehousing concepts, master data management, and building scalable reporting architectures; experience designing data validation frameworks and quality assurance processes
 Demonstrated experience managing and reporting ESG metrics, emissions accounting (Scope 1, 2, 3), circularity, waste, water, and sustainability KPIs; familiarity with building templates for multi-stakeholder data collection
Proven ability to explain complex technical analyses to non-experts, work effectively in multicultural teams, and adapt quickly as tools, priorities, and business needs evolve; fluency in English
Advanced proficiency in Power BI or Tableau, SQL for data querying and transformation, Python or R for scripting and automation, and expert-level Excel (data modeling, pivot tables, automation) is a plus.
Excellent communication skills in English

Essential Attributes

Data quality focused – You validate assumptions, document logic, and catch issues early.
Systems thinker – You understand data flows and downstream impacts.
Self-sufficient builder – You prototype practical solutions independently.
Clear communicator – You explain technical topics clearly to non-experts.
Adaptable – You stay effective as needs, tools, and priorities change.
Collaborative – You partner well with IT while representing sustainability needs.

You will join a dynamic, talented, high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Consultant - Reinsurance Business Data Analyst for a role focused on helping clients better understand, structure, and use their data to support data driven decision-making.

You will work closely with client stakeholders across multiple domains, including but not limited to finance, underwriting, claims, etc. to analyse data structures, clarify business definitions, identify gaps, and translate complex domain concepts into clear, scalable data-driven solutions such as data products and analytical datasets.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Card Network Office (Card Networks)
new_jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Global Partner Engineering and Operations (PE&O) team is a vital part of Stripe’s Global Partnerships organization, playing a key role in our overall success. We manage the technical and operational dimensions of new and existing strategic product partnerships and programs. Positioned at the nexus of product development, engineering, and partnerships, we facilitate seamless collaboration essential for supporting Stripe’s rapid growth.

Our team is a diverse mix of technical and business professionals dedicated to executing operations with financial ecosystem partners. We ensure efficient technical onboarding and implementation, while also overseeing ongoing KTLO (Keep-The-Lights-On) activities and achieving strict quality and performance benchmarks. Additionally, the PE&O team initiates partner-agnostic programs and solutions to tackle broad ecosystem challenges, developing tools that enhance operational efficiency and scalability.

In This Role

The team is establishing a new function to oversee Card Network Compliance. In this position, you will be responsible for developing programs and processes to address Stripe’s card network changes and their implications for both Stripe and its users. This role is crucial for ensuring we stay informed about ongoing card network announcements, enhancing our strategic position, and driving operational efficiency in response to changes.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute significantly to building a function from the ground up and to help formulate strategies that align with the best interests of Stripe and its users!

What You’ll Do

Implement Release Management Process: Establish a release management process for Stripe in accordance with Card Network mandates, advising all cross-functional partners on the impacts, changes, and timelines associated with network updates. Conduct comprehensive analyses of how these mandates affect existing processes and services.
Review Card Network Releases: Review, analyze, and assess biannual card network releases to identify key initiatives that will significantly impact Stripe’s business. Collaborate cross-functionally with various teams to ensure proper visibility and prioritization of these initiatives. Facilitate communication between engineering teams and the card networks' Technical Partner Managers (TPaMs) to streamline clarifications and negotiations regarding complex mandates and programs.
Monitor Compliance: Establish a framework and process for monitoring compliance with card network requirements and internal policies. Ensure regular audits and assessments are conducted to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement strategies.
Develop Metrics and Dashboards: Create and implement comprehensive metrics and JIRA dashboards to effectively monitor, review, and analyze mandates for each release cycle. Regularly update and refine the dashboards to reflect current business priorities and challenges, enabling teams to make informed decisions and proactively address potential issues related to card network mandates.
Manage Mandate Intake Process: Oversee the network mandate intake process, ensuring timely review, assessment, and prioritization of mandates. Lead the proactive management of waiver requests, liaising between compliance and operational teams for resolution.
Engage with External Partners: Actively engage with external network partners by participating in councils, forums, and regular strategic meetings. Establish and nurture relationships that facilitate mutual understanding of goals and objectives.
Advocate for Stripe: Serve as a dedicated advocate for Stripe within the card network ecosystem, ensuring that the unique perspectives, challenges, and opportunities faced by Stripe are considered by network stakeholders.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

5+ years of experience in the payments industry, with significant expertise in working with card networks and understanding card network rules and compliance activities.
In-depth understanding of acquiring platforms and systems, and their interactions with card network products and processes.
Proficient in navigating and using JIRA for project management and tracking. Familiarity with card network portals for managing and monitoring compliance activities. Comfortable utilizing Google Workspace tools (such as Sheets, Docs, and Slides) for collaboration and documentation.
Proven track record of effectively collaborating with product and engineering teams to develop new processes and strategies in partnership with them.
Strong program and project management abilities, with the capacity to engage and influence stakeholders outside of direct control.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively engage with both internal and external partners and drive change.
Ability to thrive with minimal guidance, navigating uncertainty and ambiguity while shaping a new program and function at Stripe.
Strategic thinker adept at identifying cross-functional issues, providing innovative solutions, and communicating the implications of these solutions across existing processes, systems, and teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience at a payment service provider (PSP), card network, or high-growth technology company is preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Finance, Technology) is preferred.

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $101,800 - $152,800. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

• High ownership and impact

• Support A/B tests and evaluate new product features

• Ability to work onsite in the SF Bay Area

Preferred

• Experience with pandas, scikit-learn, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools
• Familiarity with product analytics, recommendation systems, or search
• Experience working with large or messy datasets
• Previous internship, research, or analytics project experience
